ra༅bya// namogu ru pad+ma ka ra ḍāk+ki ni ba su de wā ya: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs dpal/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha la btud nas/ bsod nams mnga' thang dus kyi rgud sel phyir/ de yisgrub thabs lag len 'di ru spro/ de yang dkyil 'khor rtsa gsum gtor ma/ mda' dar/ g.yang rgye/ g.yang phor/ phye mar/ bsang shug sogs zhal shes ltar tshags tshud byas la/ chos spyod sogs rgyun sgol ltar dang / ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa o rgyan rin po che'i rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs ma 'dres par gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ (ཿ snyen rgyan dza/la gyi nub byang sogs sirnyi :: lan gsum/ yis ma rdo spre gadza/ma 47na pa sogs gsola'adebs rnam gsum dang / skye ba kun tu sogs 31ga bsang chu byin rlabs ni/ sgrub khog las/ hūṃ bispru ta krita gas dang swa bha was sbyangs bsang chu'i nang du sogs hūṃ phaṭa: sngags nyeragacig bajod/ lha nyid 'od zhu bdud sogs bzhin gyur: mchod rdzas byin rlabs na/ hūṃ bisne ta krita sogs dang sā bha was sbyang la/ bsang chu'i nang du sogs ra ṇa dza: trī:dmigs med tshos sogs rā ḍā ( spos byung ni/ hūṃ bisne ta kritamags dang sā bha was sbyang la/ nor lha'i gsol 'debs ni e ma ho: gzhi dbyings sogs mngon gyur

raḥ2// the ga rol mo byin rlabs ni/ sgrub khog las/ skyid ma hā badz+ra ྅sogs spra ra ṇa dza: skyabs yul bskyed pa ni/ rang mdun nam mkhar sogs gsal gdab la:skyabs sems ni/ na mo: kun khyab rig pa sogs maṇ+ḍal mjug sa thob the ga: tshogs zhinga'od zhu ni/ sgrub khog las/ dza hūṃ bo he:sogs med par gyur: sngon gtor byin rlabs ni/ sgrub khog las/ rang nyid 'phags pa sogs/ dgyes bskyed gyur: mdzod sngags dang a ka ros byin gyis brlabs/ yid ma hā gu 〈co sarba hūṃ: sngon gtor 'bul ba las/ byed: 'ar shes dang nai sogs sa ma yā: bgegs la chang glu bsngo ba ni/ gzhung las/ hrīḥmigs med chos sku'i sogs bam ho: de nas gzhung gi bka' bgo na/ hūm̐ trī: ngar 'dze+en las skyes sogs phaṭa: hūṃ bzhi dang drags sngags so lngas brab/ srung 'khor ni/ hūṃ hrī: mtha' dbus med pa sogs lha bskyed las ma 'dres sku ngas su dzadags: dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ sgrub khog las/rang gi snying ga'i cesad zer sogs tiṣ+ṭa badz+ra gzhung gi/ lha tshamags gnas gsum sogs nas/ lha la bstim: sgrub khog las/ slar yang gnas ga༄/ma sogs nas/ sib

sib bstim mo: mchod pa'i 'jug gi pu dza ho: sman mchod ni/ 37 ā:hūṃ: rgyal dgongs brda snyan sogs pha la hrī: bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: ma chags dre bral sogs shog 'dzab bskul ne+e hūm̐ hrī: mi gnas dag pa sogs yā: 'dzab dmigs ni/ hūṃ hrī: bskyed pa'i sogs ye shes ngang: phreng ba phyin rlabs ni/ snye sarba dharma ga ga sogs bla mitsi ra ma ṇa sogs/sngags nyer gcig/ dbyang gsal rten snying brjod la rab tu gnas/ bla( ā:hūṃ badz+ra sogs bsnyen sgrub las gsum grub rjes/ tse( rgyan mkha' 'a17 nor lha'i dkyir 'ashesar gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum mthar o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyobs pa'i nus mthu bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas bdag dra gas sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas mchog gi dngos grub o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i go 'phang mngon sum du thob pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub phrin las rnam pa bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang /

༄༅// grub pa chen po brgyad thob pa sogs mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub dam pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ mchod pa ni/ hūṃ hrī: kun bzang rol ba sogs dza ho:bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: ma chags dri bral sogs byang chub shog gzhung gi 'dod don gsol gdab ni/ hūṃ trī: mi g.yo bde chen hūṃ hrī: dge ba o rgyan nor lha'i lha tshogs sogs regag 'di ltar bskyed sogs— de ga de nas rmang sri bkar ba ni/ hūṃ dkon mchog bden pa'i sogs phaṭa: bgegs bsgrad srung 'khor gzhung ltar ro/ g.yang gsur ni re yam̐ khaṃ: byas āḥhūṃ: chos dbyings mkha' sogs re/ga 3 badz+ra tshu: 'khor gsum dmigs med kyis zin par byas la dge ba bsngo/ spro na mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo bya/ de nas khrus chab gsol ba ni/ bdag nyid rdo rje sogs bste|ra/ sngags gcig dang skye/ a badz+ra sogs sngags brgya rtsa brjod la/ hūṃ hrī: dag byed gtsang ma sogs cig/ rnam 'joms gzung ring thung skabs bstun dang / e:dzaḥ sogs 'og gi khyim khrus ni/ hūṃḥ lha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sogs bkra shis stsol khyim bsang ni/ kyi lha shing sngon po sogs regag: 'og gi: kyai g.yang lha mgon sogs re/ga:

g.yang 'bod ni/ e ma: bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa sogs smon lam mjug gi zin par regag bar shad phud bya'o/ de nas tshogs la thog mar nyams chags bshags sbyang bya ba ni/ rang snang ye shes sogs khaṃ: kaka kaka sku sgrib bral sogs a ā: rdzas bskang ni/ hūm̐ hrī: dri med bla ma 31 rgyan sogs deXg: /tshogs bsdus ci 'grub dang rje btsun bla ma sogs stsal du gsol: sa twa ci 'grub dang / yig brgya gcig/ ho: dam tshig nyams chags bshags pa'i rgyal po khams gsum 'khor ba sku gsum klong du byang chub 31ga: nam mkha'i mthar tshogs byin rlabs ni hūṃ hrī: kun gzhi brdal khyab sogs nas tshogs phud mjug kha hi: bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ sarba dharma sogs gyur: mdzod sngags lan gsum rten snying brjod/ bskang rdzas rnams 'phags pa kun tu bzang brgyud bskang ni/ hūm̐ hrī: ma skye sogs byang chub regag dgyes bskang ni/ hūm̐ trī: skye med chos sogs ā: bshags pa ni to: gdod nas sogs ya ā: tshogs 'gugs ni/ tshogs bye/da lcags khang sogs na mo: mchog gsum sku gsum sogs dza hūm̐ baṃ ho: sogs lan gsum tshogs bsgral ni gzhung las/ hūm̐ hrī:

༄༅// mtshan bcas sogs bstab mjug/ khā hi: gnam phud ni/ bye 'og min gnas dang sogs kha hi: drangs ba ni kyai: dgongs shig rdo rje sogs la ho: bsam lhun gang skabs bya/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor lhag mar byin rlab ni sgrub khog las/ pañtsa a mṛ ta sogs pho phetī gzhung las phe1 rdo rje rgyal po sogs kha hi: tshogs mchod phul bas sogs regag bshags chung 'don de nas mdun bskyed la/ rmang sri bkar/ g.yang gsur/ g.yang bsang khrus gsol sogs gong ltar la/ sa bcud phyin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐ hrī dza: snyen nub rnga yab sogs a ā: mdun bskyed ni/ khyen ma ha 81 h+ye hrī: ka dag dbo/ngas pas sogs spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'chal mchod pa maṇ+ḍal bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs la mchod rol dang g.yang 'bod lan gsum dang / hrī 'byung ba dgrar lang / sogs gyur regag ci 'grub brjod/ g.yang 'bod bcu gsum pa bkra shis char 'bebs ni ma ma: rang snang rnam dag sogs khug skyol/ 'og ma ni/ hūṃ hrī zhes nub rnga yab sogs pha la hūṃ ā: bzlas dmigs ni rang khyen rgyan pad+ma sogs dmig: bsnyen pa dang / dzam wa'i gzungs/ rten snying dbyangs gsal sogs dang / gter bum sgrub pa ni/ khyen ma

hā shu h+ye ta sogs chos rnams migs med sogs nga la de ga:ci 'grub mthar / g.yang 'gugs ni/hūṃ hrī: mchog gsum sku gsum sogs maṅga leḥ g.yang 'gugs 'od kyi drwa ba ni hūṃ hrī: lus med ces rgyan sogs maṅga le: trī: 'byung ba dgrar lang sogs ā: e: ka ma las bzhad sogs tshogs: hrī: snang mtha'i'ajin las sogs regag e ma: bkra shis phun sa/ma 31gas pa gangs rte/ngas rnge da: 'dzam gling sogs g.yang 'bod/ g.yang 'gugs/ g.yang blan bcas rat+na maṇ+ḍal t+t+waṃ: brtan bzhugs ni/ hrī: lnga/ gnas nor bu sogs badro gter bum brten bzhugs ni sa rgyal ba sras bcas sogs tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: mchod phreng ni hūm̐ hrī: rab 'byams 'jig rten sogs/ pha la :: bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: dran pa tsam gyis sogs bstod: bsngo smon ni/ hrī: o rgyan nor lha'i sogs byang chub shog hrī: phan bde ma lus sogs dpal thob shog bkra shis ni hrī:chos dbyings mkha' la sogs bkra shis shog/ 'og gi sa bkra shis kun gyi sogs shog gsol kha ni byin rlabs ni/ gtor snod bhan+da lcang lo can sogs rā khyo sa:

༄༅// gsol mchod ni/ hrī dza: lha dbang lha yi sogs yā: kye: ting 'dzin dbang phyug sogs phobs: ci 'grub dang/ rang lugs gsol kha dang / mjug tu/ hūm̐ bh+yo: dum gcig bhan+ta sogs sa ma yā: gang zhig yid la sogs — 'bul brdo da: de nas dga' ston tshogs mchod gong bzhin bya/ bskul ba byin rlabs ni/ a: las ka pa la sogs hūṃ hrī: mi gnas dag pa sogs mdzod: chad mdo byin rlabs ni/ rdo rje dza ga ldan sogs — bdud rtsir gyur rgo āḥs: lan gsum/ gzhung las/ hūṃ bh+yo: sngon tshe bar dang sogs sa ma yu:bstan gtor byin rlabs ni: rin po che'i snod du sogs/ bro 'gugs ni/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang sogs dza hūm̐ baṃ ho: gzhung las/ hūṃ hrī: dag chen chos dbyings sogs nan: sgrub gzhung las/ bkra shis badre da nams sogs ye swa hā: mchod dmigs ni sgrub khog las/ gdag bskyed las sogs bskang bar mos la: nyu dngos su 'dresar sogs mchod oṃ gu ru ar+ya dzam bha la sa pa ri sogs tits+tsha swā hā: gong gi bstod dmigs ni/ rdo rje'i lha mo sogs bsam mo: hrī: ma bcos spros bral sogs bstod ldeb

shar: hūṃ hrī: bde ba'i gos sogs bstod: bstod par sogs bstod: ho: las nyon sogs ya ā: dbyangs gsal yig brgya gsum/ bsngo smon ni ༷: ces rgyan nor lha'i sogs re ga ka 'dir ni sogs su pra lan gsum/ hrī: mi g.yo chos phaṭa: rtsa sngags dang rten snying gcig/ bkra shis ni gong gi rang gi sogs mos la: 'og gi hūṃ hrī: dran pas dngos grub sogs bkra shis the ga ston pa 'jig rten sogs bstan pa'i sogs gnas 'dir nyin sogs 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni sogs su dza ya: de ltar du 'grub par sogs gyur cig gong gi/ na 51 gu 〈co ::sogs swa hā: mtha' sdud smon lam sogs rgyun srol ltar ro/ grol dus kyi bya ba ni/ gong gi mchod bstod bsdus pa dang / maṇ+ḍal so bdun/ sogs gang skabs phul/dngos grub ni/ hūṃ hrī: byin rlabs dngos grub sogs hūm̐ ā: hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs stsol: mchod bstod rgyas pa dang / smon lam ni/ na mo: dkon mchog rin chen sogs gyur cig g.yang 'bod ni/ 9sgo ma: bkra ༷/sa phun dza/ma bye gas sogs ste: lan gsum sogs skabs dang bstun/ khyim lha brten pa ni/ 5): de ring khyim lha sogs 'khru1ba shākyar cig zur bkol

btsa( them medazhwas:na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: byu/canasgomalha/jam dad dang mos gus gdung ba drag po yis:thal sbyar snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do:yi ma to:gdod nas 'dasangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang:lhun grub 'gags med rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho:thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan rdo rje sems:gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod:chos kyi 'byung gnas dga' rab rdo rje dang:rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng:mkhas shing grub pa mañdzu mi tra la:gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod:'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brtes pad ma 'byung:bi ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtsho:zag phung 'od skar grol ba mtsho rgyal la:gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod:blo gros dbang phyug khye'u chung ye shes dbyings:don gnyis mthar phyin rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga:brtul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul rdo rje la:gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod:don gyi rig 'dzin dpa' bo rol pa rtsal:chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro bo lod:snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma la:gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin

bsgo/ gsum ska la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag bzhengs: mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me gsal bar byas: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pa las can bu la bzhag: gu ru thugs dze+ecan la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal ba dang: sgrub mchog bsam pa yid bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i: lhag pa'i lha mchog nyid la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: rang snang dag pa dpal ri pad ma'i zhing: ston 'khor rnam par dag pa rab mched nas: 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog: sa u/:badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi :: de

ltar gsol ba btab pa yis phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel dbang dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal the tshom med do sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim phyogaces pa 'di'ang btsun chung kidhi'i skye rtags can gyis bskal ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab te yi ge pa ni pad+ma smon sems kyis bgyis pa'o:

ga:lnga grol mdzod: skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos kyang: thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje'i bla ma yis: rjes bzung dbang skar blo sna chos la bsgyur: phyi nangad byen zhi sa lam mthar phyin nas: kun tu bzang nge 'i rgyal sa zin par regag: de ltar gsol btab phyi nang babhed las rgyal: nyams rtogs yon tan yar nge'i zla ltar 'phel dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su rnam par 'gyur: the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka': shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: rmang byung rdo rje snying pa'i chos sde rnams: grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad: da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel: byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal: dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la ltos dang mthong: bka' gsang thub par srung shig nges nus ma: skal med lag tu ma re la a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par thegag sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu kyi: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: snyi: zhes pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i

shes gcig la rnam rol mtha' yas pa: bkod pa 1nga chen yangs par ro gcig bsre: ngo mtshar mchog tu mi 'gyur don dam lha: gnyis med rol pa chen pos phyag bgyi'o: sa ma ya ste: na mo dṛ na ma ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ྅ trīḥ kun bzang rol pa chen po las spros pa'i: gzung ba rang grol nyer spyod rnam pa bdun: 'dzin pa klong grol 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: dug gsum dbyings sgol sman gtor rak+ta dang: thabs shes mnyam sbyor ma rig 1nga grol bcud: ro mnyam chen po ting nge 'dzin gyi gter: sha lnga bdud rtsi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun sogs: 'dod pa'i yon tan nam mkha'i rgyan gyur ba'i: mi zad chos sku'i rang rtsal mchod sprin gyis: sa rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskangs: tshe dbang bsod nams stobs gyi dngos grub stsol: sa ma hā pañtsa rat+na pu dza ho: drug pa bstod dbyangs bya ba ni: nyu hrī ༷ ma chags gribral bde gshegs snang mtha' yas: byams brtse'i bdag nyid nam mkha' rgyal po'i gar: 'gro 'dul mdzad pa mtha' yas pad+ma 'byung: sku gsum mnyam rdzogs glong la phyag

btsan o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i bden stobs kyis: steng 'og bar gsum lha klu mi yi g.yang: btsan phyug 'phan dar che grags stobs kyi g.yang: zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phywa dang g.yang: lto sprin 'thibs bzhin 'dir khug 'dir 'dus la: rgya mtsho 'khyil ltar sgrub rdzas dpal la bstims: gza' skar bkram bzhin gnas khang bang mdzod bskyil: kha g.yang brjod ltar sa cha yul phyogs dge: dpal ldan rnam thos sras bzhin mnga' thang rgyas: tshe dbang chos dang longs spyod mnga' thang stobs:'dod pa'i yo tan rgya mtshor mnga' brtes shog: na mo rat+na tra ya yā: na mo gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni bā su de wa ye: ma hā ra dza yu tabya thā: sa bā su bā su rat+na rat+na kha dhe shrī shrīḥ kha dhe shrī shrī pa shaṃ a ma ra ṇa: a yudzñā na pubye pukhye: sarba a d+dhi:tri:a mkhye ya bsdus bsdus t+t+waṃ:rat+na sirnyi pha la khug skyol: mi nor zas gsum sarba rat+na dhi shame ṇa he sarba rat+na sidhi pha la sa: brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub brjod: gsum pa g.yang rnams brlan pa ni: cha: phan bde'i 'byung gnas dam pa chos kyi g.yang: mi 'gyur rin chen sems kyi pad+mor brlan 'chi ba

med pa rdo rje tshe yi g.yang: bla srog khams 'dus rten gyi yi ger brlan: nub pa med pa bsod nams dpal gyi g.yang: las dbang dar btsan 'byung ba'i stobs su brlan: pho lha yid bzhin dar ma'i dpal du brlan: mo lha mthing btsun sman shar nyid la brlan: dgra lha g.yul rgyal go khrab mtshon la brlan: 'go ba'i lha lnga mi yi dpal du brlan:skyobs pa'i lha dgu phug gi rten la brlan: yul lha dam can rnga thig dar la brlan: zhing lha mdzes ldan ma gzhi klu mor brlan: rta lha re man 'dod ster gang la brlan: phyug lha nor bdag g.yang gi ra bar brlan: lug lha dge rgyal g.yang gi mtsho mor brlan: ma lha bu rdzi srid kyi dpal du brlan: grogs lha dbang phyug rba lcags rten la brlan: tshong lha stobs bzhin phyag gi mazil du brlan: thab lha dpal phyug zas snod bcud la brlan: lha klu mi yi phywa g.yang ma lus pa: sgrub mchog rnams kyi dpal dang g.yang du brlan: sras bcas rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus byin gyis: phywa yi thag pa ma chad ra gur dkrigs: g.yang gi mtsho mo ma skems snum mer bskyil: phyugs kyi ra ba ma 'thor sra brtan mdzod:

btsa/ dbul 'gyed 'gong 'dre ma sdang phyi rol bsgrad: nad mug mtshon chas 'khrug sgong zhi ba dang: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon phyor: sa gsum kun khyab bde legs snang ba ce la: tshod swa sti sirnyi maṅga lam: lan gsum brjod la dbab bstims bya: me tog 'thor la shis pa brjod: bzhi ba g.yang rnams brtan bzhugs ni: ྅ trīḥ steng dredags lha be+e phywa dang g.yang khu ye: mi 'gyur mi shig rten la rak+ṣa bh+ri: bar srid mi yi phyu dang g.yang khu ye: 'pho 'gyur bral bar rten la rak+ka bye: 'og gnas klu yi phywa dang g.yang khu ye: gnyis med ro gcig rten la rak+ka t+t+waṃḥ 'byung ba snod kyi phywa dang g.yang khu ye: 'gyur med sgrub pa'i rten la rak+ka t+t+waṃḥ srid pa bcud kyi phywa dang g.yang khu ye: g.yo 'gul bral bar rten la rak+ka sbyo: rgyal blon 'bangs sde'i phyu dang g.yang khu ye: 'thor zhig bral bar rten la rak+ka t+t+waṃḥ dge btsun sngags pa'i phywa dang g.yang khu ye: chad gas med par rten la rak+ka sbyoḥbazang dgu legs pa'i phywa dang g.yang khu ye: g.yo bskyod bral bar rten la rak+ka bh+yoḥ 'khor 'das yongs kyi phywa dang g.yang khu ye: mi shig rab rgyas rten la rak+ka sbyoḥ g.yang gi ra

bzhi dpal ldan dzam lhas srungs phywa yi sgo bzhi rgyal chen sde bzhis zungs: bcud kyi snum zhag nor rgyun lha mos bskyil: dpal gyi mdangs bzang rigs byed lha mos brten:dbang gi sgo bskyed ma hā de was mdzod: tshe yi srung mda' sgog lha gsum gyis brten: phywa g.yang ma god da la la ru bskyil: phywa g.yang ma 'khyams mer mer chil chil bsdus: phyu g.yang ma ral sib sib 〈cog rug bstims: 'pho 'gyur med par su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa: rten 'brel snying po ci rigs brjod :rab tu gnas shing brtan bzhugs bya: lnga pa smon lam gdab pa ni: na mo: badzadad nams gter chen 'di bzhengs dge ba'i mthus: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde legs dpal gyis 'tsho: char chu dus bab lo phyug rtag tu legs: mi nad nor gyi god kha kun zhi zhing : tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor ba rab rgyas shing: dge spyod thar ba'i lam bzang 'dzug pa dang : mu ge mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar gyur: lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor dpal la dbang : chag sgo nyer 'tshe bkra mi shis pa bcom: dgra gdon bdud tshogs zhi zhing stong pa dang: sa gsum bde skyid dpal la spyod bzhin du: rnam mkhyen mi

bsgo/: zad sgrub pa'i 'bras bu can: mi ldog gdod ma'i btsan sa zin par regag bsngo smon shis pa rgya cher brjod de 'bras bsod nams dpal 'byer rgyas mnga' thang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': rjes rim phywa g.yang 'gugs bstim sogs: las kyi rim pa3nargya: e ma: rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: snying 'dra'i yang zab smad byung ba 'brog ban khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel brda la bstims: mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzongs der sbos : ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang : 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel: 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung: ze tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': bka' gsang srungs shig spu gri gsum dam log lag tu ma shor zhig: sa ma yu: rgya rgyargya: bla ma o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i zab sgrub gter gyi bum bzang rdzogs so gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gurgya: o rgyan gyi bsgob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' : bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim: snyi: ces pa 'di'ang dad ldan bsod nams snyan grags kyis bkra shis lha reg tsan+dan phye ma rgya chen snying po rtsi mar sogs dge ba'i rdzas du ma dang bcas bskul ngor bdag 'dra o rgyan nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshug te dag par phab pa'i dge bas 'gro khams bde
skyid phun sum 'tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig: sarba maṅga le/

gas/ bdud rtsi sman gye mchod pa ni: 31 ā:dzñā rgyal dgongs brda snyan re ga ser tshig gis brgyud: dgu ldan bla ma brgyud par bcas pa la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: yas mas brgyud pa kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung: mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin mtshungs bral rje: brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs bang mdzod la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: snyigs ma'i rgud sel o rgyan nor gyi lha: bsod nams lhun po dzamaḥlha gter bdag la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mthu dbang tshe dang chos kyi dngos grub stsol: khams gsum dbang bsgyur lha yi bla ma dang: phrin las kun sgrub dam can rgya mtsho la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i char ba phob: ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha tī: dza: mtshan ldan bhan dhar bcud bskyil a mṛ

ta: rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsi'i rgyun: mnyam pa nyid du myang bas dngos grub mchog: ma lus bde ba chen por stsal du gsol: sidhi pha la hrīḥ de ltar sman mchod phul ba yis nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim:3/: zhes pa'ang ras pa pra dzñā dh+wa dzas bskul ngor nus ldan pas spel ba maṅga lam̐/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rja snying po las: bla ma o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i g.yang gi sgrub pa byed tshe:rmang sri 'gong 'dre bkar thabs 'phral rkyen g.yul 'joms bzhugs so:

btsa/ na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye: dzam6) thal zan bsres pas gtor gzhong du glud gzugs yid mthun bkod par bya bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs rgya chen bya rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis /:dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs dang : bden gnyis bslu med nus mthu yis: 'gong 'dre bse rag dbul sri sogs: thams cad ma lus 'dir khug cig: tri ā ga ya dza: dzaḥtsū baṃ ho: rin chen ming dang gzugs mdzes dang : 'jam klas 'jigs kun bral ba yi: de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo glud gtor phun sum tshogs gyur cig: ha ho hrīḥ de nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni: tho las stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang: t+t+waṃ las yid mthun snod nang du: tra:las glud kyi gtor ma ni: hrīḥlas 'dod yon lnga ldan pa:āḥlas zad med nam mkha' mdzod: thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig: bla(:spyotshwa:hrīsaswā: bla ā:(ཿ ha ho trī: lan gsum brjod la byin gyis brlabs kye las dbang ma ga par rgyu ba yi: gnod tshe'i bsam sbor 'chang ba'i rigs: 'gong po spran dgu bse rag dang: dbul sri grong rgyag 'byung po'i tshogs: 'gro ba'i bde spyid dpal la 'khri: gang ba

btsa/ thams cad stong par byed:'byor ldan thams cad dbul bor bsgyur:yod la mi dga' med la dga':mi dang phyugs kyi srid la 'jab:kha rje dbang thang dpal la rngams:tshe dang srog la rnam par za: bkrag mdangs snum bag bcud la 'jub:log pa'i sbyor ba sna tshogs ston:nyes pa'i snang ba ma nges slong: bsam sbyor rtsub pa'i 'byung po rnams:mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan can:dkor las lhag pa'i chang bu dang:nam mkha' pho brang 'od gsal ba:'dod 'byung 'brang rgyas grangs ldan pa:mun bsal snang ba'i mar me dang :mos pa dang mthun 'theb sgyu dang:'bru nag ram ru sol khram ris:bal brgyang 'dod yon dkor nor ni: dpag yas 'jig rten khams bkang ste:rmang sri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul:dngas ba'i sems kyis longs spyod cig:byams pa'i blo yis 'dod yon rol:re zhen chags 'dzin bral bar gyis:rang gi lus la dpe longs la:gzhan la gnod 'tshe ma byed cig:bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis:brngan pa'i yas glud sbyin zin pas:ma 'khor ma blta ma sems

par: bzung ba thong la bcing pa khrol: bsdams pa klod la mnan pa khyog: zhi bas sems kyis rang sar dengs: de nas lam bstan bya ba ni:hrīḥ yas tshig dgu pa glud kyi lam: de ru lha 'dre'i lam bstan no: phyi mig re chags bral bar gyis: 'di ru 'dug pa'i skal ba med: gal te 'khru zhing 'khri gyur na: bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang khros nas: 'byung po gzhob bsregs rdul brlag 'khru1ra: de bas da lta phyir dengs (gag ñdzi hūṃ ༷ tsa ta ya pāṭa bgegs bsgrad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms: khrus dang bsangs sogs grub par bya nor lha'i g.yang sgrub brtson pa'i 'bras bsod nams mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas pad+ma'i snying thig zab pa'i skor khye'u chung lo tsā'i bgo skal mchog: ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yu: rgya rgya rgya : rmang sri bkar thabs 'phral rkyen g.yul 'joms rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu rgya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim:3ga: ces pa 'di'ang sbyin bdag pukhye'i ming can gyis bsod nams kyi dpal kha du ma'i skyes bcas yang yang bskul ngor: bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

ga66 g.yang gsur ni: sbyangs spel brgyur gsum grub nas slar:ram̐ ye zhe ma.ā hūṃ:chos nyid mkha' las ye shes 'phrul snang ni:gsur mchod dkar mngar sman dang dmar gyi rigs:'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod 'dis: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro byes gyur cig:srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: bgegs rigs 'byung po'i 'dod pa tshims shing ngoms:rigs drag sems can las snang kun dang bral: gshin po'i bar do rang snang ngo shes shog:khyad par 'gong po bse reg 'gab 'dre'i rigs: me mchod gsur dri 'di yis tshim gyur nas:rang rig 'od gsal dbyings su grol bar sgo ga:lan gsum brjod la badz+ra sum̐:

( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: khrus dang g.yang bsang byin rlabs gnad 'bebs bzhugs so:bas( na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye: rta /sgobyes bzang shing phye mar 'bru sna brlan bsangs sbyangs spel bsgyur byin gyis brlabs: khrus chab rdo rje rnam 'joms gis: sngags 'di brgya rtsa brjod la brlabs: ma/ a badz+ra bi dha ra ṇa hūṃ hūṃ sarba adṛ te swā hā: ྅ hrī dag byed gtsang ma las kyi chab: rnam par 'joms pa'i rang bzhin gyis: phug gi lha la khrus gsol lo: grib dang mi gtsang dag gyur cig: phyu g.yang dpal la khrus gsol lo: dbul sri bse rag stong gyur cig: bar gyi mi la khrus gsol lo: dbang srung rgud pa sang gyur cig: sbra dang khyims la khrus gsol lo: mnol rtsog phog pa byang gyur cig: sgo yi nor la khrus gsol lo: god 'dre byur sri brlag gyur cig: chab kyis mi 'dags gang yang med: khrus kyis mi gsal mi srid pas: phyi khrus dung las dkar gyur cig nang khrus mchong las dmar gyur cig: gsang khrus gser las 'tsher gyur cig: dri ma sgrib tshogs byang gyur

cig: bka' las byung ba'i gzungs sngags ni: ring thung skabs dang bstun te brjod: es :rba:resaX45ste 85bye a a swā hā: de nas g.yang bsangs 'di ltar ro kye: lha ༷/nga 11na pa g.yu yi 31 'dab can: dri ldan bzang shing dngul gyi me tog mdzes: mnol ba bsang byed gser gyi zhal mnga' ba: mthun sbyor shing dmar bye ru'i mig mdzes pa: bzang shing sna tshogs byur bur spungs pa las: 'byung ba me yis ngar bskyed 'bags rtsog bsregs: dgung sngon chab kyis rlan phab dri ma bkru: dud pa sman gyi nus pas mnol grib bsangs: phye mar gsur dris mu ge'i 'jigs tshogs zhi: shel tshig 'bru snas 'byor ba longs spyod spel: bzang drug ngad pas dus kyi nad yams sel: dri ro nus ldan g.yang bsangs 'di spros pas: phug gi lha zhal dung las dkar gyur cig: mi bu 'phan phyug btsan dar 'dzom par byed: ra ba rkang bzhi rta nor lug gis gang: gnas khang bang mdzod zas nor longs spyod byur: tho phyi bcud chags g.yang 'khyil phun sum tshogs: dpal ldan rnam mang thos sras dbang thang la: 'bad med 'byor ba'i rten 'brel mthu ldan shog: bkra

bas/ shis g.yang bsang phul ba'i bden mthu yis: bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas dge spyod tshe ring bde skyid dpal 'bar nas: don gnyis lhun je ba byang chub mdzadag lnga ba thegag: ces dang shis brjod smon lam gdab: mi gtsang 'bags rtsog dri ma dag: tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor ba rgyas yon tan phun sum tshogs thob 'gyur: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bstan 'gror phan pa'i chos sde rnams rin chen brda la bkod de sbas: gter bdag spu gri gsum la gnyer : dus kyi snyigs mar gyur ba'i tshe: nga sprul las can gcig gis rted 'phral gyi rgud pa gso bar 'gyur mi baspu nges pa rdo rje'i bka': sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya : g.yang bsang byin rlabs gnad 'bebs rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu rgya:3): ces pa 'di'ang sbyin bdag bsod nams snyan grags kyis dge ba'i skyes bzang du ma dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le:

gas/ khyims khrus ni:kakaka bdud rtsi 'byil ba'i byin rlabs pa'i:bcud kha 'bab chu bo bzhi yi dwangs:yum ma ki dkar mo'i rang bzhin gyis:mgon pha byes srung mar rtsi gsol lo:skyabs dgra bla rnams la rtsi gsol lo:grogs pho lha phrag lhar rtsi gsol lo:dpal zas lha g.yang lhar rtsi gsol lo:srid rtsa dkar gter la rtsi gsol lo:ma mo lha rnams la rtsi gsol lo:mi'i kha mgon lha dang srung mas mdzod:grags snyan pa che dgu dpal kha bskyed:dgra 'gong bo bse rag rgyang du bskrod:dpal tshe chos nor gsum 'dzoms pa dang:yongs bde skyid ldan pa'i bkra shis stsol:nus ldan pas so:khyims bsang ni: bye:g.yang lha mgon dung khyung dkar po bsang:dpal khri dar gser gyi ru sbal bsang: mgon nyi yag ba mo bsam 'grub bsang:gser 'od stong g.yang gi lu gu bsang:btsan stong thub ldem bu drangs dkar bsang: phyug ru ma nye tu g.yang rgyal bsang:stobs mthun chen lha rgyal rgod po bsang:g.yang ru ma dung mtsho phyug mo bsang:skyes don 'grub nor bu dgra 'dul bsang:bdud zil gnon lha chen khro

thung bsang: 'gong kha chings rgu ru dung rgyal bsang : mtha'i dmag bzlog lha chen dbang phyug bsang: steng lha g.yang char ltar dbab tu gsol: bar mi g.yang lho sprin ltar du spungs:'og klu g.yang rgya mtsho mer ltar bskyil: mi'i tshe bskyed g.yang gi dpal kha spol:don 'di phyi'i dge legs kun 'grub re ga:nus ldan pas so:

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: o rgyan nor lha'i dal du nyes ltung bshags pa sgrib bral snying po bzhugs:'a:: na mo gu ru ke ra ye: thetha joskozo zlo: chos sku sgrib bral mkha' ltar dag pa las: ye shes gzigs pa phyogs med bde chen 1nga: gu ru gangs can mtsho yi mdzad phrin las: o rgyan nor lha'i thugs rjes nye bar dgongs: blo dman 'byor chung bsod nams dman pa bdag: gnyis 'dzin ma rig dug lnga lhun 'thug pas:tshogs bsags sbyin gtong dbul zhing ser snas bcing: zas dang nor la re bas rtog sgrib bshags: yod pa bskyangs 'tsho mi khom nyon mongs pa: med pa btsal sgrub mi 'byung nyams thag gnas: re dogs nyer len chags sdang a 'thas skyon: mkha' ltar dag pa'i gnas lugs ngang du bshags: nor lha'i mi bzhed zhen chags ser sna dang:g.yang gi 'gab 'dre brnab sems ma byin blang: dpal 'byor 'phrog byed ma rig nga bdag skyon: chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i dbyings su bshags: bshags dang bshags

par bya ba gnyis 'dzin sems: gzhi med rtsa bral don la mnyam bzhag cing: mtha' grol sang yangs thig le mngon gyur na: don dam bshags pa'i rgyal po sgrib bral ma11nga: a ā: de ltar bshags pa'i rgyal po 'dis gnyis rtog sems kyi dri tshogs byang don dam ye shes mngon du 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya: brda thim snyi: zhes pa 'da'ang o rgyan rgyal tshab nus ldan khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le:

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: o rgyan nor lha'i dgyes bskyed rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba bsod nams char 'bebs bzhugaso:badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye: sgotsok+ka/rtso hūṃ hrīḥ dri med bla ma o rgyan nor gyi lhar: ma rig mun pa sangs phyir sgron me 'bul: bsod nams gter mdzod pad+ma rgyal po la: dngos kun ro mnyam bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: chos kyi lhun po gter bdag rgyal po la: 'dod yon mtshan 'dzin rang grol gtor chen 'bul:khams gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro nor lha la: chags pa dbyings sbyor rten 'brel rak+ta 'bul: 'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la: sngags kyi dga' ston dza gad a mṛ 'bul : a la la ho bde ba chen pos bzhes: 'a spyol ba ka dag sku gsum mngon gyur thegag: de ltar rdzas bskang 'bul ba'i mthus: nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyur: sa ma yu:rgya rgya rgya: gu bya: brda thim :3|: zhes pa 'di 'ang gar dbang nus ldan dpa' bos spel ba maṅga le: dza yan+tu:

'o/ tshogs bsdus ni: re ye dza: triḥ dri med ye shes gzigs pa'i mtsho skyes rje: sgyu 'phrul rol ba bde stong tshogs kyis bskangs: rlung sems dbu mar tshud te rtogs nga zlos: rig stong o rgyan nor lha'i sa thodṛ shog: bsod nams rgya mtsho rdzogs phyir sur+yas bris : sarba maṅga le:

ga:lnga zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: bla ma o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dal du: tshogs kyi mchod 'bul bsod nams mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na 〉〉 // ru ḍāk+ki ni bā su de wi shri ye: —1rte/zlasaza ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i smag rum khrod: dus kyi rgud pa shar ba'i tshe: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha la: dngos grub zhu bskul gsol gdab tshe: bsod nams tshogs bsags thabs la brtson: sa ma yā: de yang sha chang gtsor gyur ba'i: bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs sbos dang snang gsal rgya chen sbar rol mo sna tshogs sgra snyan sgogs: las rim rnam pa bco lnga las dang po tshogs rdzas byin brlabs ni: nyu hrīX kun gzhi brdal khyab yangs pa'i ka pa lar: kun snang 'dod yon bkod pa bsam mtha' yas: kun bzang tshogs kyi ma ngas spyod nam mkha' mdzod: kun khyab lha mo'i rol rtsed dgyes stobs gyur: ma ā:nyu lan gsum badz+ra spra ra ṇa dza: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: ྅ hrī: kun khyab brdal ba mi shig pad+ma 'od:bde stong 'dus ma byas pa'i gzhal yas nas: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas: dga' ston ga ṇa tsakra'i 'du bar byen: 'khrul ba ru bzlog gar bsgyur stobs

dang bcas: mnyam sbyor rol ba chen po'i da lar bzhugs: ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i dga' ston bzhes: dgos 'dod longs spyod sna tshogs char ltar phob: sa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: hrīX snang ba rab yangs srid pa bkod mdzes dpal: 'dod yon rnam dag 'dzin rtog spros bral ba'i: phyi nang gsang rdzogs ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul: sa ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi: bzhi ba bshags pa bya ba ni: ho: gdod nas dag pa'i gnyug ma sku gsum zhal lkog gyur ma rig gnyis snang dri mas sgrib: 'od gsal rig pa mchog gis bshags bgyi'o: dri bral tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: sa badz+ra sa ma ya ā: lnga ba bsgral 'dren bya ba ni ( hrī: mtshan bcas gnyis snang bdud sde dpung dang bcas: mkhyen gnyis ye shes mtshon cha 'bar ba yis: phung khams skye mched dum bur gtubs byas nas: rnam shes skye med yum gyi 1nga du bsgral: sku gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs klong byang chub nas: 'khor ba dong sprugs ru tra drung 'byin mdzod oṃ sarba ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: drug pa bstab mchod bya ba ni:྅

btsaX trīḥ log 'khrul gnyis snang 'byung po'i tshogs bsgral nas: phung khams skye mched don snying ma lus pa: khams gsum dbyings rol bde stong e klong bstabs:'khrule ba chos skur sang ba'i phrin las mdzod: sarba ru tra mā ra ya rbad kha ram khā hi: bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni pho : rdo rje rgyal po pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' nyan rol ba'i lhag sdud ma sring ging: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bar ma laṅka'i tshogs: 'dir byon lhag ma'i mchod gtor skyems bzhes la: rab 'byams phrin las ma lus lhun grub cing: rnal 'byor rlung sems ting 'dzin las rung mdzod: tshe dpal nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas shing: zung 'jug 'od sku 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: sa ma ma sarba ābye ṭa bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba niḥ tsū hrīḥ mi gnas dag pa chos sku'i dbyings sang nas: thugs rje phrin las smon lam mtha' yas pa:o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs bcas rnams: thugs dam gnad bskul gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: 'jig rten dus kyi rgud pa 'tha' dag sol: 'dod rgu'i char gyis

gangs ljongs dbul phongs zhi: skye rgu'i blo sems dam pa'i chos la dril: dpal ri pad+ma 'od du byang chub mdzod: dgu ba chad mdo bstan ma ni: shā bh+yoḥ sngon che bar dang tha ma'i bskal ba la: che mchog dbang chen pad+ma he ru gas: bka' dam la bzhag dregs pa sum cu dang: sde dpon bco brgyad phyi nang gsang ba yi: bka' srung dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: chad don dmar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: phrin las rab 'byams ma lus yongs grub mdzod: bod skyong bstan ma ya ma'i tshogs rnams kun: a su ra yi khas blangs dran mdzod la: gangs ljongs bod srung gnyer blang mi g.yel bar: dam rdzas bshal chu'i mchod gtor skyems bzhes la: mtha' yi dmag bzlog dus kyi rgud pa sol: 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: bcu ba bro mnan bya ba ni: nyu trīḥ dag chen chos dbyengs stong pa'i e klong du: gnyis snang bdud dang dam sri ru tra brub: mnan no sdang med sku dang ye shes rgya: byang chub bar du ma 'da' s+t+waṃ bha ya: nye ā:ka swā hā mā ra ya nan nan: bcu gcig dngo grub blang ba ni: ka hrīḥ

bsgo/ byin rlabs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i klong mdzod nas: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i bsod nams gter: da lta nyid du sgrub mchog bdag la stsol: 'dzad med yon tan gter la mnga' brtes regag: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba rat+na puṣ+ṭi sid+dhi pha la hūṃ ā: bcu gnyis bzod gsol bya ba ni: ho: las nyon 'khrul bas dbang gyur rmongs pa'i las: gnyis snang sems kyi 'dzin rtsol dri ma kun: mi 'chab mi sbed gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags: klong yangs ngang du bzod gsol dag tshangs stsol( rgo badz+ra sa ma ya ā: yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags: bcu gsum bsngo ba spron lam ni: hrīḥ bla rgyan nor lha'i dkyi 'khor sgom pa'i mthus: 'gro ba'i dbul phongs rgud tshogs zhi gyur cig: skye rgu dam pa'i chos lam la gzud nas: tshe 'dir pad+ma 'od du grol bar shog: lan gsum : bcu bzhi rtag chad bsal ba ni: hrīḥ mi g.yo chos sku'i gdangs las lhun grub kyi: snang cha brjod bral ka dag dbyings su ā: slar yang rig gdangs sgyu ma lta bu'i ngangaḥ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam rnam dag bya'oḥ a āḥpāṭa pāṭa: bco lnga bkra shis bya ba ni: ྅ hrīḥ dran pas dngos grub mchogartsol pad+ma

'byung : sgrub pas yid bzhin dpal ster dzam bha la: bsam pas bde stong rab sbar ḍak+ki'i tshogs: 31 rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i bkra shis re/ga: ces sogs shis brjod rgya chen dang:bsngo ba smon lam mthar rgyas bya: des ni bsod nams longs spyod 'phel : don rnams legs bzhin yid bzhin 'grub: sa ma yā: e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis: snying 'dra'i man ngag yang zab mchog 'brog ban lo tsā khyod la sbyin da dung ma spel brda la bstims: mi 'gyur bkra shis rjongs du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus: nga sprul gdul bya'i ded dpon mchog: dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang : 'phrad nas gdul bya smin grol byed: 'gro don bsam gyi mi khyab 'byung: de bar zab rgyas brda mdzod 'di thub par srungs shig spu gri gsum: gdams bcud chos kyi dpal kha mchog: g.yel med srung shig lha chen po bka' la gnas mdzod dam tshig can: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya tshogs mchod bsod nams mtha' yas dzadags so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya gsang rgya gu bya: 31 rgyan gyi bye ba dpon pad+ma se bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim:zhi: ces pa 'di'ang dad ldan bsod nams snyan grags kyis bkra shis lha reg tsan ldan phye ma rgya chen snying po rtsi mar sogs dge ba'i rdzas du ma dang bcas bskul ngor bdag 'dra o rgyan nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis

—8(na mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i dge bas 'gro khams bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig: sarba maṅga le:badz+ra de nas drangs ba len pa ni: kye dgongs shig rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: 'dod yon ro mnyam chen po rtsa dgyes par bzhes te brtse bas rol: a la la ho: ho:tshogs kyi rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: gtsang sme gnyis rtog bral ba'i rgyu: bram ze gdol ba khyi phag sogs: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: sarba sid+dhi pha la a la la ho:ces brjod kun gyis rol bar byas: 'di'ang nye bar mkho ba'i phyir: sbyin bdag pukhyes bskul ba'i ngor: nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba'o: dge'o legs so: maṅga le:

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:brgyud pa rin po che'i bskang ba gtsug gi rgyan gcig bzhugs:gas/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: jugaskya)dza/tsho3 hrī:ma skyes brjod bral chos sku'i dbyings nyid las: phyogs ris mi dmigs ye shes gzigs pa can:rtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams kun:gnas 'dir dgongs la ye shes gzi byin phob:srid zhi'i mgon gcig ye nas rdzogs sangs rgyas:kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba'i thugs dam bskang:kha sbyor bdun ldan yon tan mtha' yas pa:ma/ngas sku rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskang:gsang chen bka' yi sdud dang bdag po mchog:rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug thugs dam bskang:dri med gzigs tshul gsung gi rdo rje ngoms:'od snang mtha' yas zer 'khrigs thugs dam bskang: rgyu rkyen las 'das ko sha'i snying por son:rang byung mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang:o rgyan srid skyong rgyal khams chos kyi 'dul:shan+ta rak+ṣi ta yi thugs dam bskang:bsil ba'i tshal byon mkha' 'gror chos

'khor bskor: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer thugs dam bskang:'og min sa spyod mtsho gling gsang sngags spel: sngags pa blo ldan mchog srid thugs dam bskang: za hor yul bskyangs lha lcam 'od skur sbyor: pan chen pad+ma saṃ bha'i thugs dam bskang: mdo sngags bstan bdag mnga' gsol lha ma'i phul: rgyal ba shakya seng ge'i thugs dam bskang:'jigs lta kun 'thar smon log mthu yis gzhom:drag pa seng sgra ngoms pa'i thugs dam bskang: chos srid dpal yon dgos dgu 'byung ba'i gnas:gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang:rgya bal bod yul lha 'dre ar la gtad:drag po me yi phreng ba'i thugs dam bskang:nam mkha' mdzod gter rin chen sgron me mchog:rdo rje khro bo lod kyi thugs dam bskang :snyigs ma'i bod 'bangs rgud sel thugs dam can: 31 rgyan nor lha gter bdag thugs dam bskang :bsam yas lhun grub bka' gter chos char phab: o rgyan rin po che yi thugs dam bskang: las can bu dgu bde gshegs 'dus pa'i smin:ston 'khor phun sum tshogs palithugs dam bskang:smra ba'i nyi ma chos kyi rgyal por

btsa/ bzhengs:khri srong lde'u btsan po'i thugs dam bskang:thugs kyi dbang thob nyi ma'i zer la pheb:dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskang:gsung gi dbang rtags spyi gtsug rta skad 'byung:grub chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs dam bskang:sku yi bka' babs brag las tshe chu bton:gnyag pa ye shes zla shar thugs dam bskang:yon tan bdud rtsi thogs med grub pa'i rje:gnub ston sangs rgyas ye shes thugs dam bskang:'phrin las gnyer thob phur pa'i lha zhal gzigs:gzungs ma ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang:ma mo bran bkol sde brgyad btson du 'dzin:'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes thugs dam bskang:brgyud gsum chig rdzogs rtogs pa phul du phyin:grub chen khye'u chung lo tsā'i thugs dam bskang:mchod bstod bka' babs sde dpon bran du khol:phur thog dpal gyi seng ge'i thugs dam bskang:lo tsar grags kyang don gyi paṇa ṭi ta:drag sngags mdzod 'dzin be+e ro'i thugs dam bskang:smon lam rnam dag gter gyis 'gro ba 'dul:rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang :

mtha' ma'i gnya' gnon skal ldan 'ja' skur sbyor: bdud 'joms gro lod rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang: snyigs mtshang rgud sel zab gter mdzod 'dzin pa: gar dbang bzhad pa rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang: ngo bo gcig las rnam rol mtha' yas pa: sprul pa bsam mtha' yas pa'i thugs dam bskang: pad+ma'i bstan 'degs las smon 'phro 'dzoms pa: chos bdag bu slob rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: gter gyi lde'u mig phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas: gsang yum rig ma'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang:dngos sam brgyud pa bdun rdzogs bstan pa'i gzhi: las 'phro dag pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: zab chos gtsug bkur zhabs tog mel tshe mkhan: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: hūṃ hrīḥ snang stong yul bral mchod pas spyan la bskang: grags stong brdzod 'das mchod pas snyan la bskang: gsal stong 'dzin med mchod pas thugs la bskang : rig stong spros bral mchod pas yon tan bskang: bde stong 'od gsal mchod pa'i 'brin las bskang: gnas lugs rang bzhag kun bzang sprin phung

ba:lnga gis: don dam ye shes bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: bskang gyur rgyal thabs spyi blugs mchog dbang stsol: gdod ma'i bum skur mnyam rdzogs byang chub shog:de /sta/ /skang bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs: nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': skal pa can gyi dpal du shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: brgyud bskang gtsug gi rgyan gcig rjogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya:sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu bya: o rgyan mkhan po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o : brda thim 3|: zhes pa 'di 'ang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pra dzña badz+ra dh+wa dza'i bkra shis wa reg bcas te nan tan chen po'i bskul ba dang: slob bu se ru'i rus 'chang prasnye'i ming 'dzin pas bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du kho bo nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes bkra shis rma yi lung pa nas dag par phab pa sarba maṅga lam̐ dza yan tu/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i kyil zhabar gyi: dgyes bskang dri med shel breng bzhugs so:bsgo/ na mo gu rje pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni bā su de wi gri ye: (1sgokhye/tho bskang rdzas yo byad gang 'os bsags: dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod du spro sbyangs spel bsgyur la byin gyis brlabs lhar gsal rol mo' sgra bcas te: sne hrīḥ skye med chos skur byang chub mnga' brnyes pa: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: lhun grub thig le'i dbyings su 'ub chub pa: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: lta sgom mkhyen pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : sin+tu'i dwangs mtshor pad+ma'i sbubs las 'khrungs: o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs dam bskang: rgya bal bod yul gdul bya smin grol mdzad: bka' drin mtshungs med bla malithugs dam bskang: dus ngan 'jigs skyobs smon lam mtha' yas pa: snyigs ma'i skyabs mchog lha lnga'i thugs dam bskang: dbul phongs rgud pa mtha' dag sel mdzad pa'i: co rgyan mkha'

'gro nor lha'i thugs dam bskang:phyi nang 'byung ba'i rtsub 'khrugs gzhom mdzad pa'i:'byung ba'i lha mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang:'dod rgu'i longs spyod char ltar dbab pa yi:nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang:khams gsum lha yi phywa g.yang stsol mdzad pa'i:dbang phyug ma hā de wa'i thugs dam bskang:byad phur 'jigs tshogs zhi zhing stong mdzad pa'i:gtsug tor chen mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang: rang bzhin rnam dag thugs rje 'phrin las can:pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang:tshad med thugs rjes 'gro khams dngos sprugs pa'i:mgyogs byed las mdzad rnams kyi thugs dam bskang:nyu trīḥgazung ba rnam dag phyi mchod bdun gyis bskang:'dzin pa rang grol 'dod yon lnga yis bskang:dug gsum ro mnyam sman gtor rak+tas bskang : thabs shes zung 'jug byang sems bcud kyis bskang:re dogs ro snyoms lta ba dag pas bskang: 'dzin rtog zang thal sgom pa mnyam pas bskangs:gnyis 'dzin sems grol rnam rgyal spyod pas bskang: bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pas bskang:

btsa( khyab brdal rig stong dzadags pa chen rnge ra ā:de ltar bskangs bas tshogs chen rdzogs:don rnams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub:sa ma yā:e ma:rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs dam mthil:snyigs dus rgud pa gso ba'i sman :khye'u chung lo ༷'i dpal shar ba:rten 'brel stson lam 'bras smin phyir:bkra shis rdzong la gab pa'i bcud:dus bab khye'u chung nus ldan pas: sred len bral ba'i brda mdzod las rnam par rdol ba bka' sdod tshogs:dmar ma wa dgu la sogs pas: thub par srungs shig dam tshig can:sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:dgyes bskang dri med shel phreng rdzogs so: gter rgya:gtad rgya:sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya gu bya:o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:brda thim :lja:ces pa 'di'ang sbyin bdag bsod nams snyan grags kyis gsol sman gyis dwa jas ma sogs kyi skyes bzang po bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dus kyi rgud pa gso ba'i lag bsam rnam dag gi mkha' 'dza'i 'phrul brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel:sarba maṅga lam̐:

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba 'phrin las kun stsol bzhugs so:badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma rge ra ye: sgasmozlosazo tshogs dang skyems phud mchod byas te: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyi: bh+yo: 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing: sa spyod sprul ba'i dur khrod brgyad: yul chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: he ru ka yi gnas mchog bcu: 'brel ba las kyi yul nyer bzhi ljongs lnga gling drug gangs nyer lnga: phug gsum tsa ri pad ri 'od: bkra shis rdzong la brten bcas pa'i: mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma: dpa' bo dpa' mo rdo rje'i ging: shugs chen mgyogs ma las la myur: dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor byon: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i bcud la rol: rnal 'byor nyams bskangs rtogs pa spor: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel:'gal zla nyer 'tshe phyogs ngan thul: bcol ba'i las mdzod sa ma yā: tsho( ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza la khā hi: ces brjod tshogs skyems gtsang sar gshegs: 'phrin las yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur:

sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya:gnas srung bskang ba 'phrin las kun stsol rdzogs so:gu phya brda thim:phyog:ces pa 'di'ang dad ldan bsod nams snyan grags kyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel:sarba maṅga le:

bas/ zab gsang rdo dze+esnying po las: bla rgyan rgor lha la brten pas: sa bcud byen 'bebs dpag bsam ljon shing bzhugs so:badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: zathaglusgojamaci sbyar spos dud btang rol mo lol snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: nyu hrī dza: lto nub rnga yab gling dbus dpal ri nas:rak+ka'i rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gdong dmar bod 'bangs skyobs pa'i dam bca' can: khye shes dad pas bskul lo thugs rjes dgongs: snyigs ma lnga brdos nad maston gzings langs skabs: sa yi bcud nyams skye 'argya'i g.yang nyams pas: rtsi bcud lo 'bras btsa' than ser bas skem: sngon gyis dam dgongs rgud gsos byin phob cig:smon lam log pa bra byi'u'i bu yug 'tshubs: nyams thags srin bu 'bu than sna tshogs pa: khrag tshos du ba na bun rdul bye 'tshubs: thams cad bsal phyir bsod nams gzi byin phob: mtha' yi smon log rgya 'dre 'byung po yis: bod khams mi phyug bsod nams phywa dang g.yang: gang bar mi 'gyur bri bar byed dus 'dir: pad ma drag por

bzhengs nas nus byin phob: skye dgu'i tshe lo mar bri rkyen gyis 'phrog : dus 'dir 'chi med tshe yi gzi byin phob: bsod nams mnga' thang snum zad ma mer ltar: nyams par gyur skabs bcud g.yang stobs byin phob: zas nor longs spyod dgra 'dres hab thob skabs: rnam mang thos sras bsod nams gzi byin phob: rtsi bcud lo 'bras dkar thog bcud yal dus: lha yi dga' ston bdud rtsi'i gzi byin phob: thub bstan mdo yi sgron me nyams dma' dus: gnas bstan dgra bcom tshogs gyis gzi byin phob: gsang sngags bshad sgrub chom pos sma phab tshe: rig 'dzin brgyud gsum bla mas nus byin phob: khrel med rkun po lang la shor ba'i tshe: chos skyong drag rtsal can gyis mthu byin phob:'ja' lus brgyud pa'i shul lam snyogs rnams la: snang bzhi chig rdzogs bsgrod pa'i dbang byin phob: dus kyi mar gsham rgud tshogs ru 'dzing yang: rdzogs ldan gsar tshes lta bu'i byin chen phob: chos dang 'jig rten bsam dgu lhun grub cing: sdig med dge legs chos kyi dbang byin phob rgo badz+ra a we sha ya a ā: zhes byin dbabs par bya'o:sa ma

dgye(4 'debs: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar gus phyag 'tshal:na mo bṛ na ma nyo de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni:ka hrīḥ gzung bas ma gos phyi mchod sprin ltar gtibs:ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod pa bla na med: stong nyid nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kun: blo yis blang nas o rgyan nor lha mchod: sgo ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho:hrī 'dzin pas ma bslad nang mchod 'dod yon lnga: snang stong gsal stong bde stong ro mnyam sprin: sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che: thams cad o rgyan nor lha dgyes phyir 'bul: ma hā dzñā na sarba pū dza ho:hrīḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi shar ba'i sman chen po: snang srid ro mnyam chen po'i bā lir+ha: gzung 'dzin dhu tir dag pa rak+ta'i skyems: ma lus o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar 'bul: sa ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bā lir+ha khā hi:hrīḥ kun tu dga' ba nyams bzhi'i rnam 'gyur can : sgeg mdzes glu gar ngom pa'i rig ma ni: bcu drug phyag rgya ye shes las sprul nas: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i gsang gsum bskangs: sa ma hā dzñā na mu tā sarba pū dza khā hi:hrī:chos nyid stong pa de bzhin nyid mchod dang : snang

srid bde spyor bdag gnyis thugs rjes bsgral: bro gar glu yi mchod sprin mtha' yas pa: gnyis med mnyam pas o rgyan nor lha mchod: blang dor med par thug rjes rab bzhes nas: tshe dbang chos dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol: sa ma hā pū dza sarba sa ma ya ho: khā hi: de nas malkol ni: ྅ sngi stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i khyon: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla dang: khams gsum lha gnas dpal 'byor bsam mtha' yas: srid pa bdag du bzung dang ma bzung nor: zad pa med pa klu yi gter kha dang: chos dbyings nam mkha'i rgyan gyur mchod sprin gyi: rab mdzes bkod ldan phyi yi maṇ+ḍal dang: dngos pos rab dben 'od gsal nang gi rten: gnas lugs rang bzhag chen po de kho na: tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir o rgyan nor lhar 'bul: chos srid dpal yon rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza ho: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni:hrīḥ dbu la rin chen gdugs mchog spyan gser nya ljags la pad+ma tshem mnyes dung dkar dang: sku la rgyal mtshan thugs gar dpal bebasgyu mgul du bum bzang 'khas

badz+ra brten 'khor lo rnams: o rgyan nor wa'i sku la mnga' dbul bgyi: thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgyes bzhes nas: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dbang thang dpale yon kun: bdag cag sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: sgo ma hā rat+na maṅga lam pū dza ho: de nas rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni:hrīḥ bkra shis rgyang grags nad sel ghi haṃ sman: dbang sdud li khri gsol mchog zho yi rdzas: bgegs 'joms yungs dkar rab gsal a dar+sha: tswa mchog ku sha shing tog bil ba rnams : blo yi blang nas o rgyan nor lhar 'bul:thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgyes bzhes nas : tshe dpal bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phywa g.yang stsol: ka ma hā rat+na sarba pū dza khā hi: de nas rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni: hrī: chos kyi 'khor lo 'dod 'byung nor bu dang: bde mchog khyim bdag dga' ster btsun mo yum: rdzu 'phrul rkang 'byor stobs ldan gnyis 'thung dang: phas rgol g.yul 'joms dmag dpon rin po che: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul: srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs bdag la stsol: tho ma ṇi rat+na sarba byu dza ho: de nas mchod pa gzhan 'bul ba ni:

hūṃ hrī: 'bru sna bdun btags phye mar spungs ba ni: gangs dkar shel ri gnam la gzengs pa'i dpe: g.yang can nor bcud mar gyi them skas gsum: 'ja' sprin gdong lnga gangs la 'khyug pa'i dpe: dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ni: bkres skom dbul phongs rgud pa sel ba'i rten: dkyil 'khor mdun du mdzes par bkod pa ni: lha g.yang mi la 'bebs pa'i rten 'brel rdzas: g.yas su bdud rtsi 'o phud bshams pa ni: dkar thog mi nub 'phel zhing rgyas bskyed dpal: g.yon du ja chang dar zab spungs ba ni: rgya hor sog gi phywa g.yang 'bod pa'i rten: gro nas mang po phyur bur brtsigs pa ni: rong rnams kun nas 'bru g.yang 'gugs pa'i rdzas: sman sna 'bras kyi tshom bu bkod pa ni: rgya gar kha che bal bo'i g.yang sdud rten: rta nor lug gi spu sna bsags pa ni: cog ro stag gzig bal bod g.yang bkod dpal: go khrab sna tshogs rol mo yongs rdzogs ni:ge sar 'brug yul dpal 'byor bsags pa'i rten: srid pa'i nor sna gsob tu bsgrigs pa ni: khams gsum dpal la 'byor ba'i rten 'brel sgo: mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bu'i

bas/ mda' dar ni: tshe g.yang srid nor phywa yi rten bzang yin: 'dir tshogs lhag bsam dkar zhing mos 'dun che: nor lha'i bsod nams stsol ba'i skal ba 'dzoms : de ltar rten 'brel che sam e ma rmad: 'byor ldan yon bdag sgrub mchog rnal 'byor gyis: bkrag gsal dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i zhal phyes nas: phun tshogs yo byad bkod mdzes rgya cher bsags: snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo'i sgras bskul na : o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha gtso 'khor bcas : bkra shis chos g.yang 'phel phyir 'dir byon la: sna tshogs mchod sprin sgrub rdzas dpal la rol: bod nas srin po 'dul byon gong thang lar: chos kyi rgyal por thugs dam bcu gsum bzhes: rdo rje'i tha tshig 'gyur ba mi mnga' bar: bsgres skom dbul phongs rgud pas mnar dus 'dir: 'khor bcas phywa g.yang dge mtshan bcud phob cig: mi la 'chi med tshe yi byin phob cig: nor la 'dzad med g.yang gi dpal stsol cig: zas la 'gong med nus bcud 'phel kha bskyed: rigs bzang mi nub srid kyi rgyun thag bsrings: cog ro klu bzang rta g.yang 'di ru

khug:ta zig dge rgyal gnags g.yang 'dir 'dus shig:bal bo a rgyal lug g.yang dpal kha bskyed:rgya gar rgyal po'i 'bras g.yang 'dir khug cig:rgya nag ja dar gos g.yang deng 'dir stsol:hor gyi go khrab mtshon g.yang ma lus khug ge sar rgyal po'i bdud 'dul chos g.yang bsdus:tshe ring rnam drug mthun bzhi'i dpal g.yang bskyil:rong pa'i nus g.yang 'brog pa'i mar g.yang khug:rnam mang thos sras dpal 'byor phywa g.yang stsol:'khor los bsgyur ba'i mnga' thang stobs g.yang bsdus:rdzogs ldan bkra shis snang ba'i phywa g.yang khug:brtan g.yo srid pa'i dge mtshan yod do cog: 'dir khug 'dir bsdus 'phel rgyas mi nub par:bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyun bzang po sgrub mchog rnal 'byor yon bdag bcas la stsol:yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol 'debs na: 'bras bu chud mi za mdzod o rgyan rje:dngos grub rgyang thags ma ring nor gyi lha:phrin las phyis su ma g.yel ḍāk+ki'i tshogs:dam tshig dus la bab so sa ma yā:sa ma hā ra sa dza gad me sa bā la ya ma da na sarba pū dza kha hi: de nas mda'

bsgo/ dar g.yab la kyi bslu med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo:dge mtshan phyu g.yang ma lus 'grub gyur cig:mda' stong dpa' bo thabs chen rta mgrin yab:mde 'u shes rab rang bzhin phag mo yum:mda' rgyud byang chub sems kyi da la che:bcu drug tshig ni bde dang stong pa'i 'gros:dar tshon ye shes lnga yi 'khor lo la:sgo ni bde gsal mi rtogs mtshon pa'i rdzas:gser ni mi 'gyur rin thang ldan pa'i nor: mig mdzes shwa ni gzhon chung 'tsho ba'i rten:byu ru mig gsum skyes pa'i bla rten dang:g.yu byang skyon bral za ma mo yi rten:bal ni longs spyod phywa g.yang bskyil ba'i rdzas:thams cad yongs rdzogs bkra shis mda' dar 'di:lta spyod gdeng ldan rnal 'byer bdag cag gis:mchod ni tshe lha rgyal ba rigs lnga mchod:bsor ni dpag yas nam mkha'i gnas su bsor:lha srung mi la 'khor ba'i dmu thag yin:mi dang dgra bla 'grogs pa'i mthun rdzas lags:srung mda' brag la 'jo ga pa'i thabs chen yin:bla tshe nyams pa gso ba'i mthu ldan lags: tshe mda' 'di las ngo mtshar che ba dkon:g.yang mda'

'di las bsod nams lhun chags nyung: snod kyi 'jig rten 'byung lngar ma 'dus med: 'byung ba lnga la brten pa'i phywa dang g.yang: dpal yon phun tshogs rnam pa ma lus kun:ma rgyud mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i byin rlabs dang: ye shes lnga yi gsang lam la drangs nas: sgrub pa'i rdzas dang gnyis su med par bsre: srid pa bcud rnams khams lngar ma 'dus med: khams chen nyer lngar brten pa'i phyung dang g.yang: che drag stobs rtsal 'phan dar dpal yon kun: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i mthu stobs nus byin dang: ye shes lnga mtshon dar gyi sna la drangs: dpal mdzod g.yang rgye'i bcud dang ro gcig gyur: srung mda'i steng ngos lha rnams sprin ltar gtibs: lha yi phywa g.yang ma lus rga ra ra: lho sprin mer bzhin 'dir khug 'dir bsdus la: tshe chos nor 'dzoms g.yang rten dpal la bskyil: bar na mi rnams bro gar khrigs se khrig: mi yi phywa g.yang sna tshogs me re re: sbrangs char rdol bzhin 'dir khug 'dir bsdus la: tsho chos nor 'dzoms g.yang rten dpal la bskyil: 'og na klu mo sna tshogs shigs se shig: klu yi phywa g.yang rgya mtsho kyi

ga64 li li:rtsi thog rgyas bzhin 'dir khug 'dir bsdus la:tsho chos nor 'dzoms g.yang rten dpal la bskyil:o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha gtso 'khor bcas:srung mda' 'di dang sgrub rdzas sna tshogs la:rten chos brtan bzhugs rtag par thugs rjes skyongs:rigs ldan mi g.yang rab tu 'phel gyur cig:bcud ldan zas g.yang rab tu 'phel gyur cig:'byor ldan nor g.yang rab tu 'phel gyur cig:skyid ldan tshe g.yang rab tu 'phel gyur cig: bde ldan 'khor g.yang rab tu 'phel gyur cig: chos ldan bkra shis bya ba mthar phyin re ga:rten snying lan bdun la sogs brjod:des nas bsang gis brngan byas te kyi 'byurngo ba chen po rin chen sa gzhi dzasabakra shis ba gam mtho la brjid pa'i steng:steng ma lha yi bdud rtsi dbab pa'i shing:dgongs sngon rlan dang nyi zla'i drod kyis bskyed:'jig rten mi yi mthun snang sbyor ba'i chas:snang srid lha 'dre'i gdug pa zhi ba'i rdzas:'og ma klu yi cod paṇa tshul du bsngags:dogs mo sa yis bu bzhin nor bsrings ba:bdud rtsi can gyi shing sna 'di dag kun:'byung ba me la sbyar ba'i rten 'brel

las: dud pa 'bags rtsogs sbyong byed sman bsung 'thul: spos ring dud pa lta bus lha rnams bsang: khams gsum lha yi phywa g.yang 'di ru phob: bde skyid lha dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub stsol: sbos 'bring dud pa lta bus gnyan rnams bsang: dregs pa can gyi phywa g.yang 'di ru bsdus: nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: spos thung dud pa lta bus klu rnams bsang: zad med klu yi phywa g.yang 'di ru bskyil: dpal ldan nam mkha' mdzod kyi dngos grub rtsol: dud 'gro pa tra lta bu'i nor lha bsang:bsod nams longs spyod phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig: rnam mang thos sras dpal 'byor dngos grub stsol: sbos dud 'ja' 'khyugs lta bus ḍak+ki bsang: bde stong 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i phywa g.yang stsol: bsang dud kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin dpung gis: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dgyes pa bskangs: bsang dri 'dod lnga'i phung pos sde brgyad brngan:phywa g.yang las sgrub ru nga phrag dog spongs: bsang gsur re ba ngoms la 'byung po tshims: 'gab 'dre bse rag dbul sri zhi gyur cig: 'dzam gling bde phyir lha bsang ring

btsa/ mo bkod:chos srid 'phel phyir lha mgron rgya mtsho brngan:phywa g.yang rgyas phyir sgyu 'phrul ltad mo sprin:dpal 'byor 'dzom phyir mchod bstod bskangs bar bgyi:legs byas de mthus yangs pa'i rgyal kham kun:bde skyid chos dang ldan pa'i bkra shis stsol:de nas g.yang 'bod ni:hrīḥ snang mtha'i thugs rje gdul bya'i dpal mtshor gzigs:ko sha'i pad tshal dbang rgyal pad sdong khar: ya mtshan rmad byung snying po hrīḥlas bskyed:yab yum rus rigs las 'das sprul pa'i sku:ḍāk+ki'i sprin 'khrigs mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang:skye 'chi med pa che dbang rig 'dzin mchog:ya mtshan mdzad 'brin thugs rje mtshan mtha' yas:rgya bal bod yul chos kyi sgron me sbar :rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung lngar rang dbang brgyur:lha srin dregs tshogs dbang bsdus dam la btags:'gro ba'i bde skyid gter gyis phan bde mdzad:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs rjer bzhugs:sa gzhi zhabs bcag sgrub gnas byin gyis brlabs:srin po 'dul dgongs dus kyi 'byung 'gyur dang:bsam yas bkur sti sku tshabs mchod 'bras

bstan: bod 'bangs yongs la zhal ta snying gtam rtsal: mang yul phyogs pheb mchod rten bde ba'i drung: chos rgyal btsad pos 'o dod 'bod pa'i dus: gces nor bsam 'phel lta bu'i man ngag ni: bcu gsum rdo rje'i zhal bzhes mi g.yel bar: dus kyi mar gsham rgud pa sna tshogs kyis: mnar bcom bod 'bangs sdug pa'i skabs la thug:mkhyen brtse gzigs shig ma hā gu ru rje: thugs dam bskul lo o rgyan rin po che: dbyings nas bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs: mi 'dod sdug bsngal nyes tshogs mtha' dag bzlog: bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid dpal yon ni: yar ngos zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig: hrīḥ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe:sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol 'debs na: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyis: bsgres skom dbul phongs sel bar zhal bzhes bzhin : stong gsum phywa g.yang ma lus 'di ru khug: sa phyogs yul 'dir bsod nams longs spyod ldan: gnas skabs nor 'byor mthar thug chos la spyod:

gas/ phongs rgud zhi zhing rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub: o rgyan chen po'i gsang gsum mngon gyur re ga: ci mang brjod la phywa g.yang rgyas par dmigs: skabs 'dir g.yang 'bod bcu gsum pa ci mang brjod: o rgyan nor lha'i gzungs dang dzam lha'i gzungs: rten snying dbyangs gsal bcas pa ci 'grub bzla: me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnas par bya: de nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrīḥ (1 gnas nor bu spungs 'dra'i dga' tshal 1nga: rten 'brel brtse ba'i rjes chags nor gyi lha: phywa cha g.yang rten rnams la brtan par bzhugs: 'phrin las mi yi gsos su 'byung gyur cig: sā sti sid+dhi maṅga lam tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra de nas bstod pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs rgud pa sel: bsam pa'i mod la 'dod rgu'i char rgyun 'bebs: sgrub la srid zhi'i mthar 'khyol dngos grub sbyin: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar phyag 'tshal bstod: bsod nams chen po ri rgyal lhun po 'dra: dngos grub rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: snyan grags dpal yon chu rgyun bzhin du stsol: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar phyag 'tshal nyi zla gsar tshes lta bu'i tshe g.yang stsol: lho sprin phyug mo las lhag nor

g.yang 'bebs: phan bde'i 'byung gnas dam pa chos g.yang spel: o rgyan nor lha'i gsang gsum klong la bstod: de nas bsngo smon ni hrīḥ 30 rgyan nor lha'i dkyir 'khor zhal phyes nas: phan bde'i 'byung gnas bya ba rin chen brtsams: lhag bsam rnam dag dge ba gang mchis kyang: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo bar bgyi: de'i mthus snang srid rnga yab dpal rir shar: bde chen 'gyur med dpa' bo mkha' 'gror sad: o rgyan nor lha'i gsang gsum mngon gyur nas: sku dang ye shes dgongs sang byang chub re/ga: lan gsum:de nas bkra shis ni:hrīḥ chos dbyings mkha' la gzugs sku'i nyi ma shar: rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis re/ga: dngos grub sprin char gdul bya'i gsos su 'bebs: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bkra shis bde stong dga' bzhi'i rtser son mkha' spyod ster: 'bum phrag dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshe chos bsod nams srid gnyis dngos grub sbyin: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i ngo 'phrod ngang bskyangs gdengs chen bzhi dang ldan : thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i bkra shis rlabs chen 'phrin las zab cing rgya che ba: yang

btsardo bcud rdo rje snying pe'i bkra shis regag: rol mo sgrogs shing shis pa rgya cher brjod: khyad par tshogs ston yang yang bya: snang gsal mar me grangs ldan phul: zhal zas yon chab la yang 'bad: de'i mthus zlogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: don gnyis 'byung bar the tshom med: sa ma lā: grol dus g.yang gtad bya ba la: stan dkar 'bru tshom bkod pa'i steng: yon bdag gos bzang rgyan cha 'dogs: byang dkar bgo bzhin bde bar gnas: maṇ+ḍal phul bcug phywa g.yang 'bod: de nas g.yang gtad bya ba ni dang po 'dod 'jo ba dkar dang: dung gi lug gu gtad byas te: che brjod smon lam gdab pa ni: na 31: dasko/na mdzadag rin chen gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: de rang gnam la bkra shis nyi zla 'dzoms: gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa mang pos bskor: sa la dus tshod bzang pos bkra shis stsol: e: g.yang 'dzom 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dung mdog 'di: srid pa phywa rje rgyal pa'i phywa rten yin: dngul dkar lug gu rtse 'jo mkhas pa 'di: srid pa g.yang rje rgyal po'i g.yang rten lags: g.yu yi rwa rtse 'od kyi rnam par 'khyugs: dmu rje rgyal po'i phywa g.yang 'dzoms pa'i brda: rna mchog rtse zhing rat+na lnga yis mdzes: gtsug rje rgyal po'i phywa g.yang rdzogs pa'i dpe gser mig

gsal ba zung re 'dzoms pa ni:bzang po'i mthu mthong thams cad 'du ba'i rten:rlung 'byin shangs khung mjes par snang ba ni :kun tshor dri zhims g.yang gi snang ba ngoms:dung gi so 'grigs bar tshags dam pa ni:'dod yon ro mnyam zhen med 'gyed pa'i rtags:byu ru 'am ni dar ljags mnyen mo bkra:smra mkhas lce bde tshos ston stsol ba'i dpe rmig bzhi lcags kyi rang bzhin sa la brten:g.yang gi ra bzhi rtag tu 'tsho ba'i brda:mjug ma dar skud lta bu g.yas su dkrugs:gnag rnams 'phel rgyun ring zhing rgyas pa'i rtags:nu bzhi bde bcud 'o mas bkang ba ni:mi grangs rtsa dkar phyug g.yang 'phel ba'i don:spyi gtsug nor bu la zhu'i sa bon tsam :bod 'bangs spyi yi bsod nams 'phel ba'i dpe:zhal nas bā su phem phem sgrogs pa yang:stong gsum phywa g.yang ma lus 'bod pa'i brda:'od dmar shel gyi mdog bzang ngoms pa ni:mi bu gdong drug bsod nams 'dzoms pa'i rtags:brtse ba'i mdangs bzang byas shing bstan pa ni:nang mi phyu g.yang yon gyi bdag por stsol:de ltar 'dzom pa'i bkra shis ba dkar

badz+ra 'di: g.yang gi sna 'dren phywa yi rgyab skyor yin: bden tshig grub pa'i rten gtad me tog dor: dpe brjod rtags kyi smon lam gang yin pa: deng dus 'dir 'tshogs rnams la smin gyur cig: de nas g.yang rdzas rnams mdun du drangs so kyai bden gnyis bslu med nus mthus phywa dang g.yang : tham cad ma lus 'dir khug 'dir 'dus la:'gyur med stag gzhi dang ni seng gzhi'i steng: bkra shis bya thabs dang ni g.yang mdzod brtan: bden pa'i smon lam gang btab 'grub gyur cig: skabs 'dir g.yang 'bod gang 'dod bskyar de nas khyim lha brten pa ni: 'o phud mchod la 'di skad do: e: de rang khyim lha brten na rten yar chos: 'khor 'das dge mtshan phywa g.yang rten yar chos: rin chen gser gyi khang pa ma gas shig: mdzes snang g.yu yi gdung ma ma chag cig: 'od 'bar shel gyi ka ba ma 'gyel zhig: 'phel phyugs sbra khyims rkyen gyis ma sprugs cig: g.yas su ma yo g.yon du ma 'chug cig: phu ru g.yu sbrangs lding ba ma zhar shig: bar la gser gyi ru sbal ma mkhun shig: mda' la lcags kyi rten phur ma bud cig: sbra gur mkhar la g.yang lha rten

du 'dzug: bkra shis smon lam gegs med 'grub par re/ga: de nas bang mdzod lha brten ni: e: phun tshogs bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma la: bang mdzod g.yang gi 'khri shing lha yi brten: sna tshogs bang ba bang sgo lde'u mig gsum: mi 'gyur phywa dang g.yang gi brten gyur cig: nam zla dus bzhi'i rgyal mo gang la'ang: rgyu sbyor yon bdag nang mi g.yang bdag gi khyims mdzod g.yang ra zas nor bcud kyis gang : stag sgo gzig sgro dred sgro ne'u le'i skyal: rin chen dar zab sman gyis rtag tu brten: phywa sgo g.yang sgo ma stong bab ma chung: 'bru drug dpal gyis snod cha yongs su bskyil : de 'dra'i phywa g.yang ngo mtshar mi nub par: smon lam gsol btab gegs med 'byung gyur cig: de nas 'o zho sogs gtad la:e: phun tshogs bya ba gang brtsam 'grub gyur cig: yon bdag dpal phyug khyod la phywa g.yang brten : bzho zo skyon bral be'u ldang sgyu thags gsum: phyu dang g.yang gi rten can khyed la gtad: phyug gcig brgya ru 'phel ba'i g.yang thob nas: glas stod dkar po lug gis gang bar re/ga: mas sked khra bo rta yis mdzes gyur cigaḥ klas smad nag po
zoshe
