gas/ byin gyis rlobs: tho badro ku li mal sman ma ṇi thar byung wa shing ku ru swā hā: sa ba su ba su:rat+na rat+naḥkha dhe dṛ bṛ:a yur sarba ma phye waṣ+ṭaḥg ga ni:bā la ya:a pra ti puste:a:d+dhi:tri:a gar+sha ya t+t+waṃ rat+na sirnyi pha la khug skyol:mi nor zas sogs dhi bṛ ma ṇa he parna rat+na sidhi pha la hūm̐ ā: spyorjes: hūṃ hrī: zla gam dgu rdogasadabang gi dkyil 'khor nas: rjes chags bzhad pa'i gar ngoms rta mchog rgyal: gar dgu'i nyams 'khyud bde stong gzi byin 'bar: phyag g.yas lcags kyus 'khor 'das dbang du sdud: g.yon pa'i zhags pas snang srid bran du sdom: dpa' ba'i chas brgyad mtshan ma med par spras: dbang chen 'dul glus ma mo mkha' 'gro sdud: zhabs bsgrad gar gyis bdud dpung kha lo bsgyur: rdo rje'i gad rgyang pro yis khams gsum 'dul: rab 'bar me yis gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin bsregs: dbang gi 'od kyis lha 'dre mi gsum bskul: dregs pa'i dpa' skong sngon gyi dam tshig can:sngon gyi dam dgongs bu yis mos ngor byon:bkra shis bum par

g.yang rten bzhugs su gsol: dgos 'dod char rgyun stsol phyir phyag bgyi'o: srid pa'i dpal yon nor sna 'bul gyis bzhes: ma rig 'khrul pa'i nongs pa mthol lo bshags: nyams chags sor chud thugs rjes nye bar skyongs: 'khor 'das dpal 'byor longs spyod phywa dang g.yang: 'chi med tshe dang srid pa'i 'jigs skyobs chos: dbul sel nor sna bkres skom zhi byed zas: 'jam mnyen reg bya btsan phyug 'phan dar g.yang : mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'chad nyan bsgom dang sgrub: sde gnyis dpal 'bar sbyin bdag gdul zhing rgyas: lugs zung rgya mtsho rdzogs ldan ltar 'tsho phyir: bkra shis phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol: bu nor tshe chos btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzoms: bde skyid phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs: ma hrīḥ pad+ma ta krita ma hā krota h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: sa bā su bā su: rat+na rat+na kha dhe sh-i dṛ: a yu sarba : ma phyi waṣ+ṭaḥ ga ga ni:bā la ya: a pra ti puṣ+ṭi: a:d+dhi:tri:a ma ya sbyo rat+na sid+dhi pha la khug skyol mi nor zas sogs dhi shra ma ṇa he parna rat+na sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ a: de ltar g.yang 'bod bcu gsum pa:

— tsā/ bzlas na phywa 'bebs bsod nams 'phel: 'dod pa'i don ni thogs med 'grub: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': sa ma ā: e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis: thugs kyi yang bcud rda rje snying po'i skor: grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen pra la bstims: mdo khams rtse shod bsham du dgongs brda sdom: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus skabasu:nga sprul las can gcig gis rted par 'gyur: 'gro don 'phrin las byang nas byang phyogs rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan rnga yab dpal rir 'god: bka' gsang srungs shig spu gri mched gsum po:dam nyams lag tu ma thegar dam du srungs: thugs sras rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du sprod:sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:them med g.yang 'bod bcu gsum pa rdzogs so: gter rgya:gtad rgya sbas rgya:zab rgya:gsang rgya:gu rgya:brda thim o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka':bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o:shud bhe: snyi:zhes pa'ang lung zin chos nyid grags pas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig:

btsan zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: o rgyan nor lha'i bzlas dmigs thugs rje'i rgyud bskul dngos grub gter mdzod bzhugs so:btsa/ na 31 gu dza pad+ma ka ra ye: rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus pad+ma 'byung: mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs: snyigs dus 'gro ba rgud pas mnar ba'i tshe: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor sgrub la brtson: lta /midzadadze sa ma yu: bdag mdun bskyed bzlas mchod bstod bskang tshogs 'bul: g.yang 'gugs g.yang bskul g.yang 'bod grangs ldan bya: bdag bskyed bzlas pa tshad 'khyol rnal 'byor bas: mdun bskyed nor wa bsnyen cing bskul ba ni: rang bla rgyan pad+ma phyag rgya zil gnon rtsal du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskyed o rgyan nor lha'i thugs gar phog: thugs dam kyi rgyud bskul te: sku yi cha shes thams cad nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa spros te: snang srid 'jig rten gyi khams nas: rgyal blon 'bangs gsum gtso bo che dgu: lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi: tshe dang bsod nams bkrag dang gzi mdangs: 'byor ba

longs spyod zas nor dpal yon thams cad dang: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i dngas bcud thams cad dang: snod kyi 'jig rten: bcud kyi sems can: 'od lnga'i rnam par me re re 'dus: kyi li li drangs : da la lar bkugs: sib sib rug rug bsdus nas sgrub pa'i rdzas la bstims: gnas khang bang mdzod tho phyi thams cad phywa g.yang gi gter chen pos yongs su gang bar dmigs na mo rat+na tra ya ya: na mo ma hā gu ru o ḍi pad+ma ka ra ḍak+ki ni bā su de wa ye: ma hā ra dza ya: taduthā sa rat+na rat+na : ba su ba su: kha dhe dṛ phro: kha dhe bṛ dṛ: pa shaṃ a ma ra ṇa: a yudzñā na: a:n+ni:tri:a gar+sha ya: mi nor zas gsum sarba dhi shra ma ṇa he par+ṇa rat+na sirnyi pha la khug skyol: skabs dang bstun la ci rigs bskyar bar bya: dzam lha'i nor gzungs g.yang 'bod bcu gsum ltar: 'gug 'bod bskul bzlas tshad du 'byel bar bya: de nas phywa g.yang dngos grub 'bod pa ni: mda' dar g.yab la dad mos tshad med pas e ma : bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa gangs ljongs bod: 'dzam gling las kyi sa ba chen po dzasgyu dengs dus rtsod ldan lnga brgya'i mar gsham slebs: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs

badz+ra rgud pas mnar zhing gcod: dus kyi ru 'dzings rtsub rngams ma bzod nas: 'o dod 'bod do gu ru bka' drin can: dpal gyi ri nas thugs rjes nye bar dgongs: zas nor longs spyod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang kun: dngos grub gter bum thob sbyin bdag la stsol : tho ma hā rat+na shrī hūṃ: de nas phywa g.yang rin chen 'gugs pa ni: : trīḥ srin po 'dul dgongs gong thang la kha nas bcu gsum rdo rje'i zhal bzhes mi g.yel bar : 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams dus 'dir: sem can mu ges mnar la nyer dgongs te: dad pas gsol btab chud mi za ba dzas phyug po'i phyug g.yang ma lus gnas 'dir khug: btsan po'i btsan g.yang dar bo'i dar g.yang khug: mi nor rigs rgyud tshe dang chos g.yang khug: dpal 'byor snyan grags stobs rtsal ma lus bsdus : phyu g.yang dge mtshan legs tshogs rnam pa kun: 'dir khug 'dir bsdus 'phel rgyas mi nub par: rnam mang thos sras mnga' thang bdag la stsol: sa sā sti sirnyi maṅga le: de nas g.yang brlan bya ba 'di ltar ro: ྅ hrīḥ bkra shis rat+na rdzong bcu'i dpal mdzod 'dir : o rgyan

mkha' 'gro nor lha sras 'khor bcas:phywa g.yang dpal 'byor rnams pa ma lus kun:mi yi tshe srog brten phyir rab tu brlan:g.yang gi ra ba brtan phyir dpal g.yang brlan:phyug gi mtsho mo rgyas phyir g.yang brlan no:rig sngags rgyun mi 'chad phyir g.yang brlan no:mkhas btsun bu slobs 'dzom phyir g.yang brlan no:btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzom slad g.yang brlan no:chos rgyud bstan pa dar phyir g.yang brlan no:bkra shis las mtha' brtsan phyir g.yang brlan no:g.yang gi ra bzhi dzam lha rigs bzhis srungs:phywa yi sgo mo mkha' 'gro sde bzhis skyongs:srung mda' rin chen ma hā de was bsrings:bcud kyi snum zhag nor rgyun lha mos bskyil: tshe yi ka ba srog lha gsum gyis brten klung rta'i ka chen ge sar dgra blas bskyed:rma g.yang zas nor dge bsnyen spom ras stsol:phywa g.yang ma ral sib sib rug rug bsdus:phywa g.yang ma god da la la ru bskyil:phywa g.yang ma 'khyam mer mer chil chil bsdus:mos ldan sgrub mchog yon bdag bcas la stsol:tho swā sti sid+dhi rat+na maṇ+ḍal bye:de nas rten bzhugs mchod bstod bsngo smon dang: bkra shis mtha'

— tsā/ brgyan dang bcas gzhung ltar bya gnad kyis bsod nams longs spyod dpal 'byor thob: yid gnyis mi dgos rdo rje'i pad+ma'i bka':sa ma yā:e ma:rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was:ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyi: thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor:grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad: mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der gong pra sdoms:ma 'ongs snyigs ma rtsub 'gyur gzings langs che: sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor nus ldan rdo rje dang :'phrad nas bstan 'dzaci bde skyid nyi ma 'brungs: don gnyis lhun grub 'brel tshad don ldan no:bka' yis mi bsgru rdo rjes mdud dam po dam ldan spu gri gsum la gnyer du bcol :thugs sras rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpa la du sprod:snod min lag tu ma shor dregs pa'i tshogs: sa ma yu: rgya rgya rgya:bzlas dmigs thugs rje'i rgyud bskul dngos grub gter mdzod zhes bya ba rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya:zab rgya:gu h+ya:o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka':bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o :brda thim 3/:zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dam pa mkhan 'jig med dam chos dang:sos ga'i mkha' sprin gyi zhal ngo ba dharma gīrti zung nas bkra shis pa'i skyes bzang du ma dang bcas yang yang bskul ba dang chos kyi bdag po shes rab thogs med 'gyur med rgya mtsho pad+ma chos 'phel gsum gyis bskul ba yang : don dang ldan phyir kho bo bdud

'joms nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gros gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni zhi snyan ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel : sarba maṅga lam̐/ rib:tshu na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na mo be+e shra ma ṇa ya ma hā rā dza ya: tar+ya shā: su mu su mu: tsan dha tsan dha: tsa ra tsa ra : ka ra ka ra ki li ki li : ku ru ku ru :mu ru mu ru : sto ru tsu dza3 san+ta pa ya: ad ma nam nyid dan : an da ra dhu ra sā hā : na mo be+e shra ma ṇa ye swā hā: dha na dha ye swā hā: na mo rat+na pa ri swā hwa: mi nor zas gsum tham cad dhi shra ma ṇa ye he par+ṇa rat+na sidhi swā hā: g.yang 'bod ni: hrī snang mtha'i 'phrin las dbang rgyal pad sdong khar: ya mtshan rmad byung mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang :snying nas 'bod do thugs rjes nye bar dgongs: sa phyogs 'di ru bcud g.yang rab 'phel zhing: bde skyid dpal nor 'byor ba phun tshogs shog: zhes rus pa'i ngor nus ldan pas so:

gas/: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: mdun bskyed o rgyan nor lha'i dgyes bskang mchod 'phreng man+ta ra yi do shal bzhugs so:bsgo/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: 23rgya(〈spyo sku gsum rigs 'dus pad+ma 'byung : bde chen 'bar la'i rgyan du brten dus kyi rgud pa sel ba'i phyir: o rgyan nor lha'i g.yang sgrub bstan sa ma yā: de yi cha lag zab mo rtsa dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i 'phreng ba ni: man+ta ra ba'i do shal bstan gzhung dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas rnams: rgyu gtsang spus legs bkod mdzes par dngos 'byor yid kyi sprul byas te: hūṃ trīḥ rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: hūṃ ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye asnye pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: hūṃ hrīḥ rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: bsil ldan gtsang ma'i zhabs bsil kun : ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: 31 rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: a ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye pāhūṃ pū dza ho: hūṃ trīḥ rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i me tog rigs: ting 'dzin rig pas

dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod rgo ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye pur+sha pū dza ho: hūṃ trīḥ rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: dri zhim bdug sbos sna tshogs kun ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: ka ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye dhu pe pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: hūṃ hrī: rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: mun sel snang gsal ci mchis pa: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: 3/ rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: khro ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye a 'o/ ke pra tits+tsha pū dza ho:hūṃ hrīḥ rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: dwangs bsil ngad ldan dri chab kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: tho ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye gharnye pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: hūṃ trīḥ rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: ro bcud ldan pa'i zhal zas kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: sgo ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye nai wikhya pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: hūṃ hrīX rab 'byams 'jig rten zhing khams su: dbyangs snyan rol mo'i bye brag kun : ting

badz+ra 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha mchod: sgo ma hā gu ru ba su de wa ye shabha pra tits+tsha byu dza ho: de ltar phyi mchod 'bul ba'o: ྅ tshi dbang yul //rdzan pa rnam dag pas: snang stong gzugs kyi bye brag kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod: tho ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye ru pa pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: shā spyo dbang yul 'dzo na pa rnam dag zhing: grags stong sgra yi bye brag kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod:oṃ ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye shabha pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: shā hṝḥ dbang yul 'aṛn pa rnam dag pas: bde stong dri yi bye brag kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod rgo ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye ghan+dhe pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: shā ༷ju dbang yul 'ardzan pa rnam dag pas: myong stong ro yi bye brag kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyi 'khor mchod: sa ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye ra sa pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: nyu stso dbang yul 'dzon pa rnam dag pas: myong stong reg bya'i bye brag kun:

ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod: sa ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye spar she pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: hūṃ hrīḥ dbang yul 'dze+en pa rnam dag pas: rig stong chos kyi bye brag kun: ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur te: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod rgo ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye dharma pra tits+tsha pū dza ho: de dag nang gi mchod pa'o:hūṃ trīḥ dga' ba'i rang bzhin phyag rgya mo: stong nyid don ston rdor dril 'dzin: bde stong nyams rgyas dang tshul can: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod: sa ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye ma hā mu tra ho nya: : trīḥ mchog dga'i rang bzhin phyag rgya mo: 'khor 'das 'gying sbyor sgegs pa mo: bde stong nyams rgyas ngang tshul can: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod rgo ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye badz+ra lwa phye ho nya: : hrīḥ khyad par dga' ba'i ye shes las: byung ba'i phyag rgyas pad 'breng spro: bde stong 'dzum rgyas ngang tshul can: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod: sa ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye badz+ra ma gye ho nya: hūṃ hrīḥ lhan skyes dga' ba'i ye shes las: byung ba'i glu mas te bu sgrogs: bde stong nyams rgyas

badz+ra: ngang tshus can: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod: sa ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye badz+ra girti ho nya: shā 1 spros bral yishas las byung bas: phyag rgya rdo rje gar brgyur mo: dgyes 'dzum bzhad pa'i ngang tshul can: o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor mchod: ka ma hā gu ru bā su de wa ye badz+ra nirti ho nya: de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni ye shes lnga: dpa' bo yab yum sbyor ba'i bcud: bde stong pañtsa amṛ ta: hūṃ sni dug lnga rnam dag o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar stobs: a ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha ram kha hi: ( sngirten 'brel 'khor ba dbyings sgol phyir: gu h+ya mu la ghirti'i khrag: rten 'brel rgyu stong dmar chen 'di: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar stobs: tho ma hā rak+ta kha ram khā hi: ྅ sngisnod kyi'ajig rten gzhong pa rtsa bcud kyi dpal 'byor gtor chen bshams: yid 'ong lha mo'i spro bsdu bcas: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar 'bul: tho ma hā ba lirnyi kha ram̐ kha hi: nyu trī shes rab rtogs pas bdag mtshan bsgral: ye shes thugs rjes gzhan snang 'dul: mnyam nyid don kyi sgrol mchod kyang: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar 'bul: sa

ma hā ma ṭaṃ dū tra pra wan tsakra kha ram̐ kha hi hūṃ hrīḥ snang ba'i thabs chen stong par sbyor: dran pa yab la rig stong yum: ye nas gnyis med bde ba che: don dam sbyor mchod 'bul gyis bzhes: tho ma hā gu h+ya bo dhi tsit+ta pū dza ho: de dag yang gsang ba'i mchod pa'o: hūṃ hrīḥ khams gsum dbang bsgyur 'khor lo dang: 'dod 'byung nor bu rin po che: rdzu'aphrul stobs ldan glang po rta: dga' ba'i rang bzhin btsun mo dang: blo ldan khyim bdag dpal gyis phyugs: phas rgol zil gnon dmag dpon rnams: bdag gzhan tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang: bsod nams yon tan mchog thob phyir: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar 'bul: tho ma hā rat+na sarba pū dza ho: dzñā hrīḥ rin chen gdugs mjes dbyangs snyan dung: mi nub rgyal mtshan mdangs ldan nya: dri med pad+ma dpal bum bcud: mi 'gyur dpal be'u chos 'khe ra rnams: bdag gzhan dus kun bkra shis shing: phun tshogs yon tan mchog zob phyir: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar 'bul: khro maṅga lam rat+na sarba pū dza ho: de dag bkra shis mchod 'bul lo:hūṃ hrīḥ dga' ston tshogs kyi longs spyod ni: me sa la sogs dpa'

btsa/ bo'i rdzas:shes rab rak+ta dpa' mo'i rten:gal phye dza gad gnyis med ngang:ma rig mun sel zhun me dang:tshul khrims dri ldan bdug pa spos:dug gsum rnam dag sha rus khrag:mdor na snod bcud brtan gamo'i dpal:dngos kun bdud rtsir rab dmigs te:dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lor shar:bdag gzhan bsod nams mchog thob phyir:o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lhar 'bul:dgyes bzhes dpal yon dngos grub stsol:sgo ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza kha ram̐ khā hi:de ni dga' ston mchod pa'o:hūṃ hrīḥlha yi mar la klu yi zhun:'jig rten mi yi mthun snang gsos:dregs pa'i nor sna rin chen dngar:dkar gsum mngar gsum dza gad sbyar:dpe ni gangs ri brjid ldan la:nyi zla 'ja' 'od 'khyugs pa 'dra:gtsug rje'i g.yang rten lug dkar brtse:phywa rje'i g.yang rten khyung chen lding:dmu rje'i g.yang rten ba mo 'khyugs:'dod pa'i dpal yon zer du spro:mthong ba tsam gyis 'dzum dang ldan: thob na ngo so dge bar mtho:grags pa srid na snyan par bsngags:dpal gyi g.yang bshos phye mar 'di: o rgyan nor lha brten phyir

mchod: phyu dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsolaci rgo ma hā dza gad ra sa bha ling ta pū dza khā hi: zas sna bye mar mchod pa'o: / hrīḥ pha dgongs sngon spros pa'i mtha' dang bral: ma dog mo sa gzhi sra brtan brten: bu lha klu gnyan gtod mi yi shing: rtsa ba brtan la sdong po 'khrugs: lo 'dab rgyas shing me tog bkra: thog bu rin chen phra ltar bkod: shing rtsi sna tshogs bcu gsum 'di: bsregs ni 'byung ba me la sbyar: zhi ni snang srid gdug rtsub byang: 'phrin las kun rtog dri ma sbyangs: byed las lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs: dud 'gros pa tra lta bur 'khyil: mig la 'dod yon sna tshogs 'phro: dri zhim 'thul bas 'byung po ngoms: nus pas lha srung lus la bskul: phyu g.yang 'khyil phyir bsang mchod sprin: tshogs chen rdzogs phyir lha bsang bkod: nyams rtogs 'phel phyir lha mgron drangs: srid gnyis thob phyir mchod pa 'bul: bdag sogs mos 'dod 'grub phyir bzhes: 'phan phyug btsan dar che grags stobs: dbang thang bu nor dpal 'byor 'bangs: srid zhi'i dge mtshan phywa dang g.yang: ma lus sgrub pa po la stsol: don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig:

—14rdo skyed ma ma ā sdo/ dra bye bā sa/ rat+na kha dhe dharma sirnyi pha la ྅: de ltar bsang gi 'ga' ston 'bul thugs dam dgyes bskangs tshogs rdzogs 'gyur: bar chad g.yul rgyal don gnyis 'grub: the tshom med da ༵ ma ya: e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs bstan 'gror shin tu brtse sems kyis yang bcud zab pa rdo rje snying po'i skor: ye shes spyan ldan 'brog mi lo tsār gtad: da dung spel ba'i dus la ma babs pas: rin chen brda la bstim shig sa ra dzu: mdo khams rtse shod gshams du dgongs pra sdoms: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i rang mtshang mngon sum dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid gsal bar byed bka' 'di thub par srungs shig spu gri gsum: smon log bdud la ma shor a tham rgya las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: mchod 'phreng man+ta ra ba'i do shal rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya: sbas rgya gsang rgya: gu hra: o rgyan gyis slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dam pa mkhan 'jig med dam chos dang: dharma kirte gnyis kyis bkra shis lha reg thabs shes rdor dril dbyangs snyan chos dung bcas te bskul ba dang: gzhan yang chos bdag praṅge'i ming dang pad+ma chos 'phel rnams kyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir: kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag

ba rte mdzod: dgra jag chom rkun 'gab 'dre bse rag thul: god 'dre kha mchu bkra mi shis pa bzlog: 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i dpal la 'byer: dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i lam la sbyor: sa lam mthar phyin nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs nas: dpal ldan yon tan zhing la dbang bsgyur shog: rnal 'byor bcol las 'di phyi'i don rnams kun gegs med yid bzhin 'khru1ba pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar mchod: 'phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grub:bar chad rkyen snang kun las rgyal: che dpal 'byor ba rgyas par 'gyur: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' zab gsang yid bzhin nor nu'i skor thugs sras bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: srung ma dbang phyug chen po'i gsol mchod khams gsum dbang sdud rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya gsang rgya: gu khya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim:snyi ces pa 'di'ang sbyin bdag bsod nams snyan grags kyis dar dang 'bru sman zas sogs skyes bzang du ma bcas nas bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpal bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs

spyan zung skye med dbyings su hrig ger gzigs: rdzi smin zhal tshom dbu sgra gnag snum 'bar: dar dkar la thod rat+na'i srog zhu mdzes : mdangs ldan pad+ma sna tshogs thod rgyan bcing: phod chos 'dung ma za ber sag lhum mdzes: rin chen snyan cha mgul phreng do shal spud: rgyal po rol pa'i stabs bzhugs gzi 'od 'bar: phyag g.yas pad+ma'i rab mdzes lcags kyu bsnams: thabs kyi rang bzhin bstan g.yo'i dpal yon sdud: g.yon pas rat+na'i char 'bebs ne'u le 'dzin: dbul phongs rgud sel bsod nams nor gter 'bebs: 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gur khang bkrag 'bar 'khyud: g.yas phyogs dpa' bo pho tshogs bro gar bsgyur: g.yon ngos dpa' mo ma tshogs snang glu len:mdun du king pa las byed nor sna stobs: rgyab tu dbang phyug nor lha sprin ltar gtibs: kun kyang phywa 'bebs g.yang sdud dgongs pa mdzad: srog gis bskul te rnga yab dpal ri nas: o rgyan nor lha gter bdag sbyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren ni: hūṃ hrīX gling dbus dpal ri o rgyan pho brang nas: pad+ma rgyal po mkha' 'gro nor lha bcas: sgrub mchog

btsan dad mos gdung bas spyan 'dren na: bsod nams dpal yon stsol bzhin 'dir byon cig: sa ma hā gu ru bidu dh+wa ra sarba sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni:hūṃ trīḥ rin chen pho brang 'od 'bar nyi zla'i khar: gu ru nor lha gter bdag bzhugs su gsol: bdag mdun gnyis med mnyam pa chen po la: dam tshigs gcig tu bsre phyir phyag bgyi'o: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ : na mo na ma ho: mchod 'bul ni: hūṃ trīḥ dngos bshams ting 'dzin las byung nor sna dang: lha klu mi yi dga' ston mtha' yas pa: stong gsum mi mjed rgyan gyur mchod pa'i sprin: o rgyan nor lha'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: o ma hā byu dza sa ma ya ho: bstod pa ni: hūṃ trī: mtshungs med blta bas mi ngom zhal bzang can: gang 'dul gsung gi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa: mkhyen gnyis ye shes kun khyab sa le ba: sa rgyan nor lha gter bdag tshogs la bstod: bzlas dmigs ni: trīḥ bdag dang mdun bskyed thugs srog sa bon las: sngags phreng pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin can: drag tu 'khor bas lha 'dre mi gsum dang: nyi zla nor bu 'byung bzhi brtan g.yo'i bcud: phywa g.yang nor

gter sub sub rug rug bsdus: bsgrub pa po yi dpal du 'dus par dmigs: cha ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍak+ki ni ba su de wā a d+dhi:tri a gar+sha ya dza dza: sarba sid+dhi bsdus bsdus pa shaṃ ku ru t+t+waṃ: dgongs pa ting 'dzin 'gyur med bya: 'phro 'du phrin las thabs mkhas brtson: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: g.yang 'bod ni: hūṃ trīḥ 'di nas lto nub rak+ka srin po'i gling: klu rgyal 'jog po'i gtsug gis bkur ba'i gnas: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba chen po'i grong: zangs mdog dpal ri pad 'od gzhal yas nas: 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig o rgyan rin chen po: mkha' 'gro nor lha gter bdag tshogs dang bcas: dad pas 'bod do dam tshig chen pos dgongs: snyigs ma'i mar gshams phong rgud 'byor nyams skabs: tshe g.yang bsod nams shin tu dman pa'i dus: chos kyi mthun rkyen 'tsho ba rab tu dman: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dbul rkyen gyis: gtsug lag chos 'khor zhabs tog bkur stis dbul: mchod dang tshogs bsags chung la sbyin gtong skam: de 'dra'i dus 'dir gzhan gyis skyobs dka' bas: sngon nas smon lam thugs bskyed dam bca'

btsa/ can:o rgyan nor lha gter bdag gtso 'khor bcas:dam tshig dus la bab po da tshur byon:g.yang bshos dkar mngar tshogs ston mchod pa bzhes:bdag cag sgrub mchog sbyin bdag grwa slob la:khams gsum lha yi phywa g.yang char ltar phobs:gling bzhi mi yi phywa g.yang sprin ltar bsdus:'og nas klu yi phywa g.yang mtsho ltar bskyil:drag can lha 'dre'i phywa g.yang gangs ltar brjid: phyi ru rgyal khams bde ba'i mnga' thang bskyed:nang du bstan pa dar ba'i zhabs tog spel:gsang ba sgrub mchog chos mthun 'tsho ba sbyor:thams cad btsan phyug 'phan dar dpal g.yang bskyil:snyan grags bkra shis dge mtshan nyin mo 'bar:lugs gnyis dpal 'byor rdzogs ldan ltar 'phel ba'i phywa g.yang ma god ta la la ru bskyil:phywa g.yang ma 'khyams mer mer chil chil bsdus:phyu g.yang ma skams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam mdzod:dam bca' dus bab dngos grub char ltar phob:sa ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ya: ba su na na kha de sidhi pha la bsdus bsdus :a pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni ba su na na kha de a n+ni:dri a gar+sha ya sirnyi pha la bsdus bsdus:sa

pad+ma ār+ya ba su de wa a n+ni:dri a ma ya sirnyi pha la bsdus bsdus: sa pad+ma ni dhi pā la rat+na ba su na na kha de a n+ni:dri a la ya bsdus bsdus: sā sti sirnyi maṅga le: rat+na ba su pusnye ku ru ye swā hā: g.yang blan ni: na mo: bkra shos chos g.yang nyi zla 'od po che: 'dir 'tshogs sde gnyis dpal la 'byor phyir blan: btsan phyug 'phan dar yid la smon pa'i g.yang: chos rgyal sbyin bdag dpal la 'byor phyir blan: grags snyan bkra shis yongs su dge ba'i g.yang: bstan pa rin chen dar zhing rgyas phyir blan: dbul phong rgud sel bsod nams dpal gyi g.yang: sems can yun ring bde phyir bstan par blan: 'jig med rdo rje lta bu'i btsan rdzong g.yang: mtha' bzhi'i rgud pa kun las skyobs phyir blan bsod nam lhun po bsam 'phel lta bu'i g.yang: rgyal khams bde phyir bdag gis blan par bya: 31 rgyan chen po'i thugs rje'i stobs ma chung: mkha' 'gro nor lha mngag pa'i las ma g.yel: pho nya gter bdag phrin las stobs ma zhan: bsam pa'i don 'di gegs med myur 'grub re ga: rat+na ba su na na kha de a d+dhiḥtri a po ya dza dza:

gas/ rten bzhugs ni:na mo:bsod nams chen po nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam shing:dngos grub rgya mtsho thogs pa med pa'i phyir:o rgyan chen po nor lha gter bdag tshogs:dam tshig rten 'dir rtag par bzhugs su gsol:rat+na ba su na na kha rde sarba puṣ+ṭi sidhi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra smon lam ni na mo bdag gis bsod nams 'di bsags dge ba yis:yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par thegag:bkra shis g.yang blan byas pa'i bsod nams kyi:stong gsum rab 'byams dpal 'byor ldan par re ga:phun tshogs sems bskyed bzang pos mtshams sbyar mthus:sgron me'i bskal pa nub pa med par shog:'jigs med rdo rje'i go cha sgom pa'i mthus:'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las skyobs par shog:rdo rje'i dam bca' gnad nas bskul ba'i mthus:'gro kun pad+ma'i 'phrin las la drangs shog:'gro don khur lci lhag bsam dkar ba'i mthus:'khor ba dong sprugs bdag gis nus par shog:lan gsum gdab po shis brjod ni:na mo 'gro kun rab rib mun pa sangs mdzad pa'i: gu ru pad+ma rgyal pos shis pa stsol:dge mtshan dbyar gyi chu

gter ltar spel ba'i: nor lha gter bdag rnams kyis shis pa stsol: bde stong nyi zla bsil drod khod snyoms pa'i: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyis shis pa stsol: 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i: pho nya dam can rgyal mtshos shis pa stsol: nyin mtshan rtag tu dge zhing skyid pa yi: bkra shis chos bzhin spyod pa'i shis pa stsol: gag yang shis brjod ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o: yang zab pad+ma'i pha nor 'di: stong gsum 'byor bas gzhal 'os min gang 'phrad ngan song skye sgo kheg: gang spyor thar ba'i lam sna zin: mthong thos dran reg don ldan pa o rgyan thugs kyi rgyal tshab zhal shes rab mos gusacan gyisamathong: rmongs pa logasalta can la ring gdul bya'i zhing bzang yongs la smin: snod min tha rgod la mi skye ye shes gzigs pa can gyisarted: semasakyi ling thog 'thib pos bsgrib: gab gsang grol ba'i rten 'brel dus: bka' 'di dbang phyug chen pos srungs: bsdam spel thabs mkhas ḍāk+kis mdzod: skal ba can gyi dpal du shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu khya: brda thim 3|: zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas nas bkra shis lha reg zhun mar gyis skyes bcas bskul ngor: kho bo nus ldan dpal gyis rdo rjes chos nyid nam mkha'i mdzod kyi brda ris las dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni: dge btsun kun los bgyis pa sarba maṅga le/

'o/ ā: ka dag dwangs mtshor bde stong pad sdong khar: kha dog mdangs 'bar gdos bral ye shes sgu: ga dar snang srid zil gnon nor lha'i tshogs: nga yi rteX pa mchog gsal snang rig pas sgrub: cha badz+ra ma hā gu ru bā su dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba sidhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes nus ldan pas bris pa maṅga lam̐:bsngo/ sngags mchod phul rjes bstod pa ni: hūṃ trīḥ bde ba'i gos can pad+ma'i zhal bzang 'jum: 'khor 'das dpal sbyin chags sogs rdul skyon bral: rgyal ba kun dngos ye shes rdo rje che: gter bdag o rgyan nor lhar phyag 'tshal bstod: ces rang slob pradzña to dzas bskul ngor: nus ldan pas bris pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le:

gas/rnya zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: g.yang 'gugs 'od kyi drwa ba mdun bskyed nor lha'i phrin las zab mo bzhugs so:—8(ma na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: ste/13)za bsod nams lhun po ri rgyal bzhin du brtan: dngos grub 'dzad med gter gyi bum pa bzang: 'phrin las rgud sel yid bzhin nor lta bu: lha mchog thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'ongs las ldan skal bzang pho mo la bsod nams dpal gyi dngos grub mchog thob phyir: o rgyan nor lha'i gsang gsum bsnyen zhing sgrub de yi cha lag g.yang 'gugs 'od drwa bstan sa ma yā de yang lha shing sna tshogs dud pa btang: tshogs dang mchod pa rgya cher bsang sbyangs spel: dbyangs snyan rol mo mang po'i sgra sbir zhing: rnal 'byor spro ba'i shugs bskyed 'di skad do: nyu trīḥ sdo/sa med tsos rgyan mkha' 'a111 tshogs rje mdzad: rak+ka pho mo sbyor sgrol chos la bkod: thugs rje'i 'od zer gangs ljongs bod la 'gyed: phrin las bsod nams gdul bya'i dpal du 'bebs: bka' drin mnyam med o rgyan chos kyi rje: rnga yab gling nas ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dpung dang bcas: glog ltar myur ba'i gzi byin 'dir phob

cig: bdag cag skal ldan sgrub mchog pho mo la: tshe chos bsod nams nor gyi phywa g.yang stsol: bde skyid snyan grags 'dzom pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: srid na mtshungs dpe bral ba'i bkra shis stsol: hūṃ trīḥ dri med shel dkar ri la nyi 'khyud bzhin: bkra shis dga' ston 'byung ba'i dpal gcig pu:'phags pa dzam dkar 'brug zhon lha lnga po: sgrub mchog dad pas 'bod do da tshur byon: btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzom pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: tshe chos bsod nams nor gyi phywa g.yang stsol: rigs rgyud bu slob 'khor g.yog phywa g.yang stsol: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis stsol: hūṃ hrīḥ 'char ga'i mdangs 'dzin gdul bya'i dpal mtsho skyong:phan bde'i char 'bebs dngos grub kun gyi gzhi: 'phags pa dzam ser gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas: dad pas 'bod do dam tshig gnas 'dir byon: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes: zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang stsol: sde brgyad dregs pa lha 'dre'i phywa g.yang stsol: che drag mnga' thang stobs kyis phywa g.yang stsol: don

gtsa/ gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol: hūṃ hrī ༷ ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la: nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi mdangs can: 'dzum sgeg brjid chags 'phags pa dzam dmar ni: rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas: dad pas 'bod do dam tshig gnas 'dir byon: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis thugs dam bskang: ma byin blang dang ser sna byas pa bshags: nongs pa sor chud brtse bas gzi mdangs ston: 'khor 'das dpal yon 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud dang: legs tshogs bkra shis dngos po ma lus pa: 'dir khug 'dir 'dus mi nub 'phel rgyas nas: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gsos gyur cig: hūṃ trīḥ rin chen be+eḍūr+ya yi lhun po la: rta bdun stong gi tshar dngar gzi mdangs can: gzugs thung khro 'dzum lhun sgeg liṅga bsgrengs: 'dod pas gdung zhing chags pa'i zil ba 'khrigs: 'phags pa dzam nag 'khor bcas 'dir byon la: bdud rtsi 'o chab bzang drug phud la rol: gdung bas skom sel brtse bas mdangs bstan nas: srid bzhi'i bde legs phyu g.yang 'dir stsol cig:

'dod 'byung bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam shing: yid bzhin nor mchog lta bu'i dngos grub stsol:hūṃ hrīḥ dgos 'dad char 'bebs bkra shis dpal yon mdzod: g.yang gi lha mo rnam rgyal nor rgyun ma: ku ru kul+le bsod nams mchog gter ma:phrin las bzhi yi gzi mdangs 'od stong 'khyugs: gdul bya yongs la phan bde'i char chen 'bebs:gangs ljongs skyabs mchog mkha' 'gro mched bzhi po: dad pas sgrub bsnyen dam tshig gnas 'dir byon: dgos 'dod longs spyod dpal yon char ltar phob : tshe chos snyan grags stobs kyi dngos grub stsol: phun tshogs phywa g.yang khug la bde legs re ga:/ hrīḥ las dbang rlung rta dar bskyed bde legs gzhi: bkra shis rtse mo dpung rgyan chos dbyings zhal rngog chags dpal bskyed pad+ma dbang gi sku:rma g.yang char 'bebs dge bsnyen spom ra dang: bdud bgegs tshar chod ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal: dam tshig dag pa'i phrin las lha bzhi po mos ldan bdag gis bsnyen sgrub gsol btab na: dgongs pa'i dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar ngoms: bsod nams tshe chos nor gyi

gas/ dngos grub stsol:btsan phyugs 'phan dar che drag stobs kyi g.yang :'dir khug 'dir bsdus 'phel rgyas mi nub par:bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i phywa g.yang stsol:hūṃ trīḥnar bdag dzam:lha nyer gcig gnod sbyin brgyad:a par tsit+ta phyug lha ljang gu dang: rta lha re man ma lha bu rdzi dang:thabs lha grogs lha zas lha mgron lha dang:pha lha ma lha zhing lha 'go ba'i lha:yul wa dam can nor lha 'khor bcas kyi:steng 'og bar gsum lha klu mi yi g.yang:zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor kun:lho sprin 'thibs bzhin mer mer chil chil bsdus:ra ba 〈 phyi gnas khang bang mdzod kun:til gong phyur bzhin yongs su gang bar mdzod:nyi zla bzhin du 'od mdangs 'phel zhing rgyas:sa gzhi rin chen ji ltar sra bstan brjid:rtsi shing nags tshal bzhin du bsgrangs yas 'phel:lho sprin phyug mo bzhin du g.yang dpal bskyil:snyan grags stong gsum khyab bzhin lugs gnyis kyi:dpal 'byor yon tan rgya mtshos 'tsho ba dang:don gnyis lhun gyi grub par byin gyis rlobs:khro swā sti sirnyi maṅga le:grangs bsogs

gzungs sngags skyar zhing me tog 'thor: de 'bras dpal yon rgya mtshos phyugs par gyur: tshogasadang ston mo mchod pa'i bre kha dpag de ltar ldan na rnams sras dpal la dbang: sa ma yā: e ma: rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sabha was: ma 'ongasa'agro la shinatu brtse sems kyis: thugasakyi yang bcud shin tu zab pa'i skor: chos kyi mig ldan 'brog ban khyod la gtad: da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzongs su dgongasapra sdoms: ma 'ongasasnyigs ma'i rang mtshangs ngomasapa'i dus: nga sprul dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rje da4 'phrad nas gdul zhing las ldan dpal rir 'god: 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod: bka' 'di thub par sprungs shig klu bdud btsan : smon log lag tu ma shor dam tshigasacan:lasacan thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shog: sam yā: rgya rgya rgya: g.yang 'gugs 'od kyi drwa ba rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya guh+ya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka': bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim:snyi: zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dam pa mkhan 'jigs med dam chos nas bkra shis wa reg thabs shes zung bcas bskul ba dang: chos bdag dharma kirtis bkra shis wa reg chos dung dbyangs snyan gyi skyes bcas bskul ba dang : chos bdag shes rab thogs med pad+ma chos 'phel 'gyur med rgya mtsho rnams kyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir: bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang brda dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni zhi snyan gyis bgyis pa'o/ sarba masgo le

gtsa/ zwab gsang rdo rje snying po las:orgyananor lha'i phywa g.yang gtad pa bkra shis pad mo'i tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so:gas/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ra ye:sbyo1ste1hrū sku gsum ston pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal:mi shig snying dbus zer 'brur rtag du rol:ma 'ongs 'gro la rgud pas mnar rnams kyis:o rgyan nor lha bsnyen sgrub sgom la brtson: sa ma ya:o rgyan nor la'i dkyil 'khor zharlo phyes nas:bsangs sbyangs spel grub sgrub pa mthar phyin tshe: rang gzhan spros bcas rnam 'gyur ldan pa yis:g.yang gtad bkra shis ku mud mdzas tshal bkod:sa ma yā:bkra shis stan dkar nas kyi tshom bus mjas:yon bdag pho mo rgyan bzang bgo bzhin gnas: phyu g.yang 'bod 'gugs gzhud ltar tshad 'khyol rjes:g.yang rdzas spyan drangs rang gis dngos grub len: khyim lha brten cing bang mdzod thabs lha brten:phye mar gtad cing 'o zho baṣā du gzhugs g.yang gtor rin chen 'bar ba gtad byas te:a mato:rin chen phung po 'dod rgu'i dpal yon mdzod:o rgyan nor lha'i gsang gsum rdzogs pa'i rten:phywa g.yang gter 'khyil g.yang ngaye sa 'bar ba 'di:'od lnga kun bzang sprin dpung rtag tu 'phro:nyi zla gza' skar 'ja' 'od gur khang phub:

lha klu gnod sbyin bu mo spro bsdu 'khrigs: phywa cha g.yang rten dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs: g.yang bde/sa ri rgyal lta bu'i dpal mdzod 'di: yon bdag gsod nams las 'phro ldan la gtad: phywa g.yang nam mkha' mdzod sang mnga' brnyes nas: bde skyid nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar bar shog: khu ye khu ye bkra shis g.yang khu ye: rat+na maṇ+ḍal bā lirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ ā: hūṃhrīḥ de nas gzhung ltar bkra shis tshe mda' gtad shis pa brjod cing me tog char 'bebs bya slar yang g.yang rgye gtad la 'di skad do: je hrīḥ rin chen gzhal rmed khang bzang 'od lnga 'khyugs: bkra shis dgos 'dod char rgyun rtag tu 'bebs: mi zad 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor spro bsdu 'gyed: gang bsam sgyu ma'i ltad mo zad med 'byung: bye brag rin chen rdzong bcur shar ba'i dbus: o rgyan thugs rje'i gter chen nor gyi lha: yid bzhin char 'bebs dngos grub gter du bzhugs: 'phrin las dpal stsol nor lha rigs bzhi dang: ma hā de wa ār+ya re man+ta: skyes bu don 'grub nor rgyun lha mo dang: phyug lha ljang gu a par tsit+ta rnams: rang rang sprul pa g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas: tshe chos

tshun bsod nams g.yang gi rten du bzhugs: bkra shis legs tshogs dpal 'byor chu rgyun 'bebs: ngo mtshar rmad byung lhun grub rten brten pa: yongs rdzogar+sha chubakod mdzes yon bdag khyod la gtad: pho rgyud bkra shis rnam sras dpal la 'byor : mo rgyud bde legs g.yang gi lha mor mnyam: bsod nams mnga' thang dbang phyugs chen por 'gran: mtha' btsan bkra shis skyes bu don 'grub mtshungs: 'di las ngo mtshar chen ba dkon lags pas: dad mos spro ba bskyed la dang du longs: yon bdag skyid kyi go 'phang thob par regag: chad rat+na maṇ+ḍal la kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta gu ṇa garma a bhi shi mi ngh+ru: shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor bar bya: g.yang brlan smon lam btab la mchod pa bkyag gzhung ltar g.yang sgo bsdam zhing brtan bzhugs bya: mtha' rgyan grub rjes spyi ltar rgyu 'grul bsdams: zas nor longs spyod sprad len mi bya'o: nang mi phyir 'jem phyi mi nang du 'jem zhag grangs son rjes bsod nams yar 'dzom pa'i: kha dge bkra shis mi yis g.yang sgo byes: skabs skabs 'gong 'dre bkar la g.yang zhal gso: tshogs bsags sdag spangs dkar po dge las 'bad: sbyin gtong byis ston bkra shis bya ba rtsom: des ni rin chen gling bzhin ci bsam

'grub: yid gnyis mi dgos rdo rje pad+ma'i bka': sa ma yu: e ma:rgyal ba'i dbang po rdo rje gaXgag sgod ngas snyigs ma'i 'gro la wag par thugs brtse bas: bsam 'phel lta bu'i yang zab rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'aprog ban khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i rang mtshang ngoms pa'i dus: nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas nad mtshon mu ges rgud pa sel: bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan lho nub dpal rir 'god chos rgyud thub par srungs shig spru gri gsum: snod min lag tu ma re ra a tham rgya: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: nor lha'i g.yang gtad bkra shis pad tshal rdzogs so: gter rgya gtad rgya: sbas rgya zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu bya: o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o: brda thim 3/: zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dam pa mkhan 'jigs med dam chos dang: dharma kirti zung gis bkra shis lha reg thabs shes rdor dril dbyangs snyan dung dkar kyi skyes bcas bskul ba dang: gzhan yang chos bdag shes rab thogs med: pad+ma chos 'phel rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te: dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni zhi snyan ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel: sarba maṅga le:

btsan wa snang lta ba gyad sku ni: a: bdag snang mi shig stong gsal 'od sku ni: 'dod dgu'i phyu g.yang sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i 1nga: o rgyan dzam lha snang srid zil gnon sku: phyag g.yas lcags kyus 'gro blo dbang du sdu: g.yon pa'i ne+e le'us sgrub la 'dod dgu 'bebs: lha lcam sbas tshul kha t+t+waṃ mchan du brten: gsang gos 'dung ma phod chen chos gos gsol: pad zhwa rgod 'phru nyi zla nor bus mdzes: zhal 'dzum chags pa'i rnam 'gyur du mas 'khyud: 'ja' 'od 1nga nas lta stangs nam mkhar bsgrad: zhabs gnyis sog lham gar bsgyur rol stabs kyis: zil gnon seng chen rngams pa'i khri la rol : gnas gsum 'od kyis rgyal kun byin rlabs bstem: 'khor 'das 'byung pa'i dpal yon dwangs bcud dang: zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i gru char rgyun: sgrub pa po yi dpal du 'beb par dmigs: a badz+ra ma hā gu ru ba su rde wa sarba sridhi pha la hūṃ: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs sgrub gyur na : zas nor longs spyod dpal la dbang bar 'gyur: yid gnyis the tshom bral ba'i mos gus kyis bsnyen sgrub lharu len byed pa gnad du shes: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di'ang
chos 'khor zhes bya bas shog bu dang bcas nas bskur ngor nus ldan pas smras te yi ge'i rig byed smon sem pas so: sarba maṅga le:

ge tshu thrarna// phrin las kyi 'dogs kha ni: mda' dar g.yab la 'di skad do: trīḥ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyam pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol 'debs na: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyis: bkres skom dbul 'phongs sel ba'i phywa g.yang khug: nad med tshe dbang mchog gi 'bru nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i bcud g.yang byin chen rgyas pa'i btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzoms pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'byor ba'i rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor 'du pa'i bkra shis las mtha' brtsan pa'i chos 'khor bu slob rgyas pa'i rdzogs ldan snang ba dar ba'i phun tshogs phywa khug g.yang khug bde legs stsol: o rgyan pad+ma bsam pa oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad ma sarba rat+na ba su kha rde na na aḥdh+ri:tri:a na ya bsdus bsdus snyirnyi pha la hūm̐ āḥ ces gu ru rin po che la gsol ba gdab pas bsam don thams cad dge legs yid bzhin du 'gyur ro: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: 'phrin las kyi 'dogs kha rdzogs so: brda thim: gu rgya ces puṅge'i ming can gyis bskul ngor nus ldan pas so: sarba maṅga le/

ra tsā/ zag gsang rdo rje snying po las: gab don gnyis pa snyi: las rim gsum las: dang po ni: skyem phud shel tshig bshams: sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs: dza: bdag nyid dbang chen he ru ga'i: mdun du sde brgyad sbyan drangs bstim: hūṃ: rig 'ardzan pad ma'i tha tshig la gnas pa'i: ye shes 'jig rten las la grub pa yi: bka' yi srung ma mgon po pho rgyud kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes phywa g.yang phrin las sgrub: e ka ral gcig dpal ldan lha mo dang: bstan ma bcu gnyis dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: bstan pa srung mdzad lha mo mo rgyud kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes phywa g.yang phrin las sgrub: dkar la gnas pa'i dreg pa lha yi sde: gnag la rngams pa'i gtum ldan gshin rje'i tshogs: dpa' brjid khro la gshe ba bdud sde yis: gser skyems 'di bzhes phywa g.yang phrin las sgrub: dmar la chags pa'i mos pa btsan gyi rigs: ser la nga rgyal gtum pa ra dzu'i sde: drag bzhad gnod sprin dpa' gtum klu yi sdes: gser skyems 'di bzhes phyu g.yang phrin las sgrub: khyad par pha skyes rgyud kyi srung ma dang: sa phyogs

'dir gnas yul gzhi skyong ba'i rigs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa 'khor cas kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes phywa g.yang 'phrin las sgrubs: sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs la dgra 'dre sgrol: las bzhi lhun grub tha tshig nyer dgongs nas: rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bsam don re ba skongs: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub: sa ma yu gnyis pa ni spos dkar gu gul tsan dan dkar po'i dud pa btang bzang drug bsres ba'i 'o phud mchod tang tang shag gi sgra bsgrags pa: dar dkar g.yab la 'di skad gyer: e ma phun tshogs bsod nams bsags pa'i nyin gung 'dir: dge mtshan sgrub pa'i yo byad legs par bkod: rnal 'byor lha sngags bsgom pa'i ting 'dzin gyis steng phyogs lha yi phywa dang g.yang rnam khug: bar srid mi yi phywa dang g.yang rnam khug: 'og nas klu yi phywa dang g.yang rnam khug: dang po phyi phud 'jig rten phywa g.yang khug: gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten phywa g.yang khug: gsum pa chen po'i 'jig rten phywa g.yang khug: bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten phywa g.yang

btsa(7 khug: stobs ldan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phywa g.yang khug: mnga' thang btsan phyug 'phan dar phywa g.yang khug: bsod nams tshe chos snyan grags phywa g.yang khug: 'du ba lha 'dre mi gsum phywa g.yang khug: 'bar ba stobs rtsal 'phan gsum phywa g.yang khug: rgyas pa 'dza ra bu sde gsum phywa g.yang khug: ma lus sib kyi bsdus la sgrub pa'i rten: phywa g.yang gter gyi bum pa chos gyis gang: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: sarba sirnyi hūṃ: yang yang brjod la me tog 'thor : sa ma yā: gsum pa ni: sbyangs spel brgyur gsum grub nas slar re yi khe: o āhūṃ: chos nyid mkha' las ye shes 'phrul snang ni: gsur mchod dkar mngar sman dang dmar gyi rigs: 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod 'dis: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro myes gyur cig: srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: bgegs rigs 'byung po'i 'dod pa tshims shing ngoms: rigs drug sems can las snang kun dang bral: gshin po'i bar do rang snang ngo shes shog: khyad par 'gong po bse reg 'gab 'dre'i rigs: me mchod

gsur dri 'di yis tshim gyur nas: rang rig 'od gsal dbyings su 17la bar regag: lan gsum brjod la badz+ra sum̐: 'khor gsum dmigs med du bzhag la bsngo smon bya'o: sa ma yā: yang zab gsang ba'i chos skor las sngags 'chang nus ldan rdo rje yis chos bdag dharma'i bzhed skong du rtog pa'i ma bslad dag par phab 'gro la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig: sarba maṅga le

ke'u(4 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gter bum bsgrub pa 'dod 'byung nor bu bzhugs gter bum sgrub pa'i cho ga ni: rin po che yi snod du gser dngul zang lcags g.yu byur man shel be+eḍūr+ya pad+ma ra ga: in+d+ra ni la mu tig rdo yi snying po: 'bras bu gsum dang bzang drug: sman gyi rgyal po gsum la sogs pa dang: 'bru sna tshogs: zas sna tshogs: bkra shis pa'i rdzas sna tshogs gzhan las byung ba ltar 'tshogs par byas la: de nas yar tshes kyi gza' skar bzang po la rten 'brel snying po dang: khams gsum srid gsum gyi zas nor ma ngas spyod 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang sarba sirnyi sbyo: ces bzla bzhin dgang bar bya'o: de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi khar btegs:rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram: bsang khrus dang rmang sri bkar ro: bde ba'i stan la blo sems dngas bar byas nas: skye/ ma hā shu byi ta dzñā na sogs kyi stong par sbyangs la: chos rnams dmigs med ka dag —1nga pa'i ngang: lhun grub 'gags med ye shes chen po'i rtsal: sna tshogs rin chen brtsegs steng pad zla'i khar: sbyoḥlas dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter bum ni: phyi gsal nang gsal dri med 'od 'khyil zlumaḥ khams gsum srid gsum 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang 'khyilaḥ snying po aḥdriḥ(ཿhrī'i 'od zer 'phrosaḥ sangs rgyas byang sems lha 'dre mi rnams kyis: tshe

bsod dpal dang srid las dbang rlung rta: snyan grags zas nor longs spyod phywa g.yang rnams: ma lus rgya mtsho chen por char babs ltar: sib sib sgrub pa'i rten la thim par dmigs: na mo rat+na tra ya yā: sidhi rat+na badz+ra sid+dhi pukhye badz+raḥ sidhi ā yu badz+ra sid+dhi pā shaṃ badz+ra sid+dhi dharma badz+ra sidhi kirti badz+ra sid+dhi shwa ra badz+ra sidhi kha dhe badz+ra sidhi bā su badz+ra sirnyi āḥsarba badz+ra sirnyi d+dhi:sarba badz+raḥ sidhi tri:sarba badz+ra sidhi nā ga ra tsa na na kha dhe bā su rat+na badz+ra a gar sha ya bsdus bsdus dza dza: sid+dhi pha la srid gsum zas nor longs spyod pā shaṃ ku ru khug skyol: ci nus dang tadu thā: rat+na bā su kha dhe a:n+niḥtriḥ.a ga ya bsdus bsdus dza dza sirnyi pha la srid gsum phywa g.yang nga la regag: ces bsnyen thung yang yang bzla: skabs 'dir g.yang 'gugs bya: de nas rten la bzhugs pa ni: 31: rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs kyis: lha klu mi yi tshe bsod nams: rten mchog 'di la bzhugs su gsol:bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra skabs 'dir tshogs ston bya'o: de nas smon lam na: trīḥ phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas: rgyal ba

gas/ yab sras byin rlabs kyis: bsod nams gter chen 'grub gyur cig: rten bsgrub dge ba'i bsod nams kyis: 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: bde dge'i lang tsho rgyas gyur cig: char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang: lo legs 'bras bu rab tu smin: mu ges rten sa zhi gyur cig: phan tshun byams sems ngang la gnas: dge ba bcu la rtag par spyod: mtshon gyi g.yul 'khrugs zhi gyur cig: sman gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs gyis: phyinang 'byung ba khod snyoms nas: nad kyi zug rngu zhi gyur cig: lha mi 'gro ba ma lus kun: dzadags ldan gsar pa'i lang tsho la: rtag par spyod pa'i dpal thob de ga: ces smon lam gdab po: 'dir 'byung po'i tshogs la gsur bsngo'o: sde rgyad yul lha la gser skyems gtor: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni: sa: bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa: nyon mongs zug rngu 'byin pa po: grags cing snyan pa stobs che ba: dus gsum dge ba'i bkra shis shog: bsod nam rgyas shing longs spyod 'phel: srid mtha' ring la lo phyug legs: mi mthun bying la chos bzhin spyod: bde skyid ldan pa'i bkra shis shog: rten bzhengs dge ba'i bsod nams

kyis: pha ma 'gro ba ma lus pa: gnas skabs dge zhing mthar thug su: rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis regag: ces brjod la me tog 'thor zhing rol mo sna tshogs 'brol lo: skabs 'dir gter sbas legs par bya'o: de nas bden grub ni: na mo: dus gsum gyi bde bar btagags pa rgyal ba sras bcas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'dza'i byin rlabs la brten nas: bdag gi bsod nams gyi gter chen po 'grub par gyur cig: longs spyod phywa g.yang rgyas par gyur cig: phan bde'i dge mtshan 'char bar gyur rig: 'gro kun chos bzhin spyod par gyur cig:mthar thugs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig: gzhan bden tshig sgrub pa'i smon lam gdab po: sa ma yā shin tu zab pa'i chos skor las: sngags 'chang nus ldan rdo rje yis: rang dang gzhan la phan phyir bris: 'gro kun sangs rgyas rgyur gyur cig: dge'o/

gtsa( tsu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: gab don gsum pashāg: las rim gsum las: dang po ni: mdun du las bzhi'i dbyibs mthun par: sa mig legs par gru gang bru: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal dang:lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ldan pa yis: dza nyu: gnas yid du 'ong zhing bkra shis pa'i sa la sngon gyi tha tshig dran nas sa yi lha mo gser gyi mdog can g.yas gter bum dang g.yon 'bras snye 'dzin pa sku stod sa nas thon pa smad sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' la gab pa'i tshul du 'dredan par bsam la: nyu hūṃ trī ༷ rnam dag dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi nas: 'phags ma sa yi lha mo gshegs su gsol: bcom ldan rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chen mo: bkra shis sa mig mdzes par bzhugs su gsol: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' gsang mdzod 'dzin ma: byang chub sems ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis: dbang chen sa yi lha mo mnyes gyur cig: sa ār+ya lo ka pri thi wi de wi lo ka pā la badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan na mo na ma ho: ar+ghaṃ pā hūṃ pu dhupe a lo ke ghadhe nai wi te shabha puts+tsha khā hi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rnams mnyes par bsam mo gnyis

pa gter bum sa mig tu bzhag la ting ting gi sgra dang bcas te: hrīḥmeḥ dbang chen sa yi lha mo'i mkha' 1nga du: yid bzhin 'dod 'byung nor bu'i gter bum bkra: phyi nang gsang ba'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs: yid 'dod mos pa'i char rgyun sib kyis 'bebs: bkra shis dge mtshan yar zla 'phel ltar rgyas: nub med tshe dpal 'byor drug dbang rlung rta: snyan grags dam pa chos kyi dngos grub stsol: gzhung las sngags ring thung gnyis ka gang skabs bzla bstod pa ni:hrīḥ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor na: dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chen mo: sa bcud bsod nams gter gyi char 'bebs pa'i: dpal ldan sa yi lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bskyal lo: dga' ston bya: gtor 'bul bya ba ni::: ram̐n chen snod nang dkar gsum bā lirnyi: kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs: zad med kun bzang mchod pa'i gter chen gyis: 'phags mchog sa yi lha mo gnyes gyur cig:bdag gi yid 'dod 'grub pa'i dpang po mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā: sgo pri thi wi de wi e dam ba ling ta khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul g.yang 'gugs bya'o: gsum pa ni: 'bar lo

bas rtsib brgyad bris pas kha kheb byas la sa bkrams te: trīḥrma rin chen sa la bkra shis gter bum 'di: 'dod 'byung sa yi lha mo'i mkha' la sba: dpal 'phel dge mtshan las byung zlobras bu ni: phyi ru rgyal khams nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi: nang du tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags rgyas: gsang ba nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel nas: rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i lang tsho legs par 'khrungs: dge mtshan chos kyi ba dan phyogs kun brdal: bkra shis 'bras bu smin pa'i dpal thob re ga: swā sti maṅga lam: rten snying lan gsum brdzod la me tog 'thor: sa yi lha mo'izhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyungs nas legs so rig kyi bu khyed kyi las rab 'byams ci 'dod sgrubs ces khas blang nas phyag byas te sa la thim par bsam mo: bden grub brjod par bya'o: sa ma yu: shin tu zab pa'i chos skor las: sngags 'chang nus ldan rdo rje yis grogs mo sa ras bskul ba'i ngor chos bdag bici'i shog gu la rtogs pas 'gre bslad med par bkod: bsod nams legs pa'i cha rkyen 'di: shan dmar sgog gi spu gris srungs 'gro phan bde dge'i rgyur gyur cig:

btsa/ 'di g.yang 'bod ni:e:ka ma las bzhad pad+ma rgyal po zhes:kha ba'i ljongs sogs mi mjed yongs kyis skyabs:ga dar chags sogs rdul bral dwangs ma'i sku:nga yi mgon gcig 'bod do thugs rjes dgongs:ca co tsam min snying khung rus gting nas:cha lang dung gling las snyan gdung dbyangs gyis ja dar mchod rdzas sprin phung stobs bzhin du: nya gang zla zhal gsal bzhin gsol 'debs na: ta ler thugs dam chen pos nyer bzhes nas: tha tshig thun mong ma yin khyad par ba: da lta nyid du mngon sum legs brtsal na: na 'chi skye rga rgud tshogs zhi bar mdzod: pa sang dbang phyug nor lha dam can rnams: pha rol kun gyi mgon du mi phyogs par: ba glang spyod kyi dga' ston char rgyun bzhin:ma lus nang pa'i phun tshogs gzhir gyur mdzod:tsa ma ra tsas kheng ldan dgra sde sgrol:tsha zer rgyud slong bgegs kyi dpa' skong shing:dza gad sngags kyi dga' ston nyer bzhes la:wa ki shwa ra nā gardzu na yis zhwa dang tog dpes lta spyod zab rgyas srol:za bsdam sgo 'byed lde'u mig rin chen gter:'a ye rig 'dzin brgyud

pa'i lam bzang po: ya yol med par srung skyobs phyogs bcur sgogs: ra gzhu mda' 'dzin dgra bla ge sar dang: la 'ur rma g.yang char 'bebs spom ra dang: sha khrag spyod mdzad nor bdag a pa ra: sa bdag bstan ma la sogs dregs tshogs kyis: ha he'i sgyu ma'i mtshang la zhen log cing: a don rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: chos kyi mthun rkyen 'dod rgu'i char pa phob: bstan pa'i zhabs tog 'grub pa'i 'phrin las stsol: thugs bskyed ma g.yel o rgyan chos kyi rje: dngos grub myur du stsol zhig nor gyi lta:dpal rir lam sna drongs shig mkha' 'a111 31gas: zhes nyams kyi sgrom rgya la mkha' 'gro bde sbyin mas bsgrags so:nus ldan pas so:

spyo dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam tshig rnams ni legs par 'dzin: lan gsum rjes su dam chu ni: he: rdo rje khyed nge gnod sbyin gyi: rang mdangs dam tshig mna' yi chu:rigs ldan bu yi lce la bzhag: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam sdom rnams: rin chen srog gi gta' ru zungs: sa ma ya na ra gaṇa: ad+ngha rak+ta ṭha ṭha: me tog sbyin zhing mig dar bkab: de nas slob ma lhar bskyed ni: bdag nyid skad cig gi o rgyan pad+ma nor gyi lha sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu'i gzi 'od 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros: snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dwangs bcud dpal yon ma lus pa bsdus te: skal ldan slob ma'i dpal du sib sib 'ub 'ub bsdus te bstim pas dpal dang yon tan rgyal mtsho'i gter chen por mnga' brnyes par bsam: o ma hā shu n+ya ta konywa nya: sgob ma'i phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las lha bskyed ye shes dbab bstim bya: de nas mig dar phye ba na: hūṃ hrīḥ bde btagags snying po sku gsum zhal: sgrib byed ma rig gnyis snang gi: dri ma bag chags thams cad kun: shes rab rig pa'i

ge rte thabs kyis bsal: sa dzñā na tsaklu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas me tog dor ba ni: nyu trīḥ sgob mamirig pa'ime tog 'di : sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: yi dam lhag pa'i lha mchog la: rten 'brel me tog dbab gyur cig: sa badz+ra pur+sha pra tits+tsha ho: de nas mthong ba bstan pa ni:tso ma ho sems nyid gresangs rgyas pa'i dal: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i 1nga : bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod de: 'di ma gtogs pa'i yi dam lha: logs na ma grub rig pa'i gsang : kun mkhyen ye shes mngon gyur mdzod: a.a.ā: de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni: shā trīX brdal khyab nā/nga yangs bum pa dzas sku dang yon tan bcud chen 'khyil: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas :snang stong zung 'jug nyams myong zhing: bskyed rim lha dbang thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas o rgyan nor lha'i sku gtad la: nyu sno dran pa tsam gyis dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: 'gro ba'i dbul phong bkres sgom nad mtshon sel: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dbang bskur ro: mnga' thang stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs

gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas dzam wa rnams sras dbang phyug yab yub kyi sku gtad la: je hrīḥ khams gsum dbang sdud nor ster lha chen po: dgos 'dod kun 'byung ār+ya dzam bha la: nor stsol lha mo dbul sel lha 'khor bcas: gter bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'dza'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni: hūṃ hrīḥ mtshan ldan bhan+ta'i snod nang du: bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i rgyun: byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas: gsal stong zung 'jug nyams myong zhing: bzlas pa sngags la dbang thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi 'inyu a: de nas sngags 'bar gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags: bcud kun 'dus pa thig le chen po'i dbang: rigs ldan skyes bu khyed la bdag gis sbyin: grags stong chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa a: de nas bgrang phreng gtad la: hūṃ hrīḥ bde gshegs zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya yi: rten mchog bla med rdzas kyi da la yis: rigs ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas:

gas/ rlung khams longs skur sbyang nus dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa a: de nas sher dbang bskur ba ni: hūṃ trīḥ bcu drug bde ster pho nya mo: yid 'ong mdzes 'dzum phyag rgya ma: rigs ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin: 'du shes gsum gyi rol rtsed kyis: bde stong ye shes nyams myong zhing: rtsa rlung thig le'i sgrib dag nas: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ྅: de nas lcags kyu gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ khams gsum srid pa'i lha 'dre mi gsum gyi: blo bsgul snang ba bsgyur zhing mnga' dbang sdud: 'dod rgu dbang sdud phyag rgya 'di gtad pas: thogs med las la mnga' brnyes dbang thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ༷rdo ྅: de nas gter bum gtad la: hūṃ hrīḥ dgos 'dod char 'bebs yid mthun bsam 'phel bzhin: dbul phongs rgud lel gter gyi bum bzang gi: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas:don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ྅: sa tshig dade nabang bskur ba ni: ྅ hrīḥ mtshan ma chig bral dpe yi dbang: ka dag dwangs ma'i 'ja'

shel 'di: rigs ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin: snang gsum shes sgrib bag chags bcom: rig stong ye shes nyams myong zhing: ka dag lhun grub gnyis med pa'i: ye shes chen por dbang bsgyur thegag: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas āXdakar gtad la hūṃ hrī skye med chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i dal: ma bcos sems kyis gsang ba yi ge ā:bde stong 'du 'bral med pa thig le'i dbang : rigs ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin bgyi'o: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas rdo rje mthing nag gtad la: hūṃ hrīḥ don dam mi dmigs spros pa'i mtha' bral yang: lhan skyes ye shes bde chen rdo rje'i dpal: bskur thob gnyis med brda yi dbang bskur ro: nyag gcig rig pa'i 1nga la dbang bsgyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a bhi ༷༷sa trīḥ de nas yon tan nus mthu'i dbang: g.yang 'bod g.yang 'gugs gzhung ltar bya g.yang rdzas gtad la 'di skad do: ྅ hrīḥ 'a:rimed che dang dbul bral nor gyi g.yang:zas nor dpal 'dzoms phywa yi bum pa bzang: dngos grub g.yang mdzod mchog gi dbang bskur ro: dpal ldan rnams sras gter la dbang 'dredar re ga: rtsa sngags mthar sarba

btsa/ rat+na bā su na na kha dhe a:::tri:a la ya bsdus bsdus sarba sirnyi pha la a bhi ༷༷/ sa: de nas phywa g.yang brlan pa dang: shis brjod smon lam rgya chen bya: de nas mtha' rten gtor dbang ni: ngh+ru hrīḥ brdal khyab ka dag gzhong pa ru1 dbyings rig zung 'jug gtor chen bshams: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i lha: sku gsum mnyam rdzogs chen po'i dbang: skal ldan khyod la bskur bar bya: lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur nas: sa lam nyams rtogs mthar phyin te: sku gnyis zung 'jug mthar phyin regag: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bā lir+ha a bhi ༷༷ skyes ā:nyu hrī: de nas bkra shis rdzas rtags dang: rgyal srid sna bdun gtad par bya: shis brjod dga' ston rgya chen bya: gnad des bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs don rnams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': e ma: rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ong 'gro la brtse sems kyis: snying 'dra'i yang zab rmad byung ba: grub dbang 'brog ban khyod la gtad: da dung spel ba'i dus ma yin: brda la thob shig sā ra dzu:mdo khams :shod gsham du sbos: klu bdud btsan la gnyer gtod dang: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus skabs su: nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje yis rted nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung dus kyi
